tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan red mda' ba chen po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru ku ma ra ma ti la na mo/ bden gnyis gnas lugs don rtog mkhyen pa rgyas/ /byang chub thug gnyis 'byongs pa'i thugs rje can/ /mkhyen rab thugs rje 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od srungs nye bar 'khor dang kun dga' bos/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bla gos khri steng nas/ /nyam thag dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag thos zhes/ /ston pa'i mdzad tshul gus pas brjod pa bzhin/ /bka' drin 'khor med chos rje rin po che/ /mthong ba'i skabs med dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /nyin mtshan bsams kyang yon tan mtha' ma rtogs/ /cha yi cha tsam gus pas brjod bgyis na/ /thub bstan nub khar dar zhes gsung pa'i don/ /bstan pa'i 'jug 'dir skyes chen khyod byon nas/ /lta spyod nyams len rnam dag spel la dgongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsams bzhin srid bzhes chos ldan rigs su 'khrungs/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs yongs 'dzin mkhas mang bsten/ /sdom pa gsum blangs srog pas gces par bzung / /thub pa'i ring lugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun la legs sbyangs nas/ /rtag chad mthar lta'i grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /rnam dag lung dang dngos stobs rigs pas bshig /log smra tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung rtogs yon tan thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /lta ba rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /sdom pa kun ldan nyes ltung dri ma bral/ /sgo gsum ma bcos lhugs pa'i ngang la bzhugs/

/spyod pa rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /bden bzhi rten 'brel phyin drug rim gnyis sgom/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /nyams len rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs dam zab mo gnad du bsnun pa'i rtags/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /rgyun du gzigs kyang rang rgyal brtul shugs brten/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung khyod la phyag tshal lo/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi che btsun 'byor ldan gyis/ /gus pas spyan drangs rnyed dang bkur stis mchod/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed gdam pa mang du zhus/ /kun gyis mchod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brug gi lo la mya ngan 'das dgongs nas/ /go rtogs nyams su myong ba'i zab don rnams/ /ston pas bstan pa gtod pa ji bzhin du/ /chos 'khor nan 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor 'das chos kun skye ba med bstan nas/ /de nyid ngang la mya ngan 'da' bzhed na'ang / /gus pas gsol btab ngo ru zhag bdun bar/ /sku tshe byin rlabs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba 'od gsal lus la brten mi srid/ /lus sems bral nas rnam shes stong par bzhugs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal yin no zhes/ /yang yang gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bsgoms 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal btab nas/ /rtags rnams ma rjed dga' spros 'od gsal 'jug /'gogs las ldang zhing sngon gyi 'phen pas 'pho/ /gsung bzhin mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tshe 'di yi dngos kyi gdul bya la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zin nas/ /'chi ba 'od gsal skabs su gzhan don gshegs/ /skye 'chi dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag /'od gsal don dam bden pa mngon du gyur/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs brnyes/ /'phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing gzhan gshegs tshe sa chen rab tu g.yos/

/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha rnams 'dus gyur nas/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho nas/ /mchod nas spyan drangs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes me yis khyod sku bzhu ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la sprin med bar snang rlung yang zhi/ /sa la drod rgyas dbyar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /rten 'brel dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad bgos pa bzhin/ /khyod gdung dad ldan lha mi grangs med kyis/ /phyogs bcur spyan drangs mchod pa'i rten du gyur/ /sku gdung rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthong thos dran reg gtam du brjod rnams kyis/ /'di phyi bar do'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dpal ldan red mda' ba/ /'dren mchog dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma kye hud bstan pa'i srog shing chag /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun phyogs bcur mthor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud thar pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyel/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi thar lam stor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud legs bshad dga' ston nyams/ /blo gsal rnams kyi re thag bcad lags so/ /kye ma kye hud lta ba'i nyi ma nub/ /klu sgrub yab sras lugs bzang su yis ston/ /kye ma kye hud dam chos rgya mtsho skam/ /thog med sku mched bshad srol su yis skyong / /kye ma kye hud lung rigs mche sder mthor/ /phyogs glang chos grags rigs tshul su yis spel/ /kye ma kye hud tshul khrims bum pa bzhig /yon shāg rnam gnyis sdom rgyud su yis 'dzin/ /kye ma kye hud spangs rtogs go rim 'chol/ /'phags seng gnyis kyi lung rigs su yis bsgrog /kye ma kye hud nyams rtogs byin rlabs yal/ /te lo nā ro'i man ngag su la zhu/ /kye ma kye hud phan bde pad tshal zung / /bshad sgrub bstan pa cig char nub lags so/ /kye ma kye hud nyam thag yid re mug /khyed sku mig gis mthong ba'i skal bas dben/ /khyod gsung rna bas thos pa'i bsod nams med/

/khyod thugs gang na bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlob/ /dge legs yon tan chu gter chen po las/ /chu thigs gcig tsam blangs la nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /zhabs 'bring gnyug ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar smad byung 'di/ /bshes gnyen bsod nams grags don bkas bskul nas/ /grangs med gdul bya'i tha shal mnga' ris pa/ /mi phyed dad thob sangs rgyas rtse mos sbyar/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu sdom byas nas/ /bla ma mchog la gus pas phul ba yis/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar 'khyong pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ༈ //bden gnyis gnas lugs don rtog mkhyen pa rgyas/ /byang chub thugs gnyis 'byong ba'i thugs rje can/ /mkhyen rab thugs rje 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces pa 'di mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i bdag nyid mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal ldan red mda' ba zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis kun rdzob kyi bden pa gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad/ spyi mtshan rang gi ngo bos stong par thugs su chud cing / rang mtshan lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra ltar gzigs pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dang / don dam bden pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar thugs su chud pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' bas na mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas pa'o/ /'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las grol bar 'dod pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i go bgos shing sgrol bar byed pa'i sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi thugs gnyis 'byongs pas na thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'o/

/de lta bu'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnyam pa'i lhag pa gangs can gyi khrod na med pas 'gran zla dang bral ba'o/ /bdag nyid chen po'i zhal mnga' nas/ srid zhi 'byongs par lta ba'i shes rab dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje gnyis/ /res 'ga' res 'jog res 'ga' zung 'brel bsgom/ /zhes gsung bstod par/ chos rje blo bzang grags pas ༈ mkhyen rabs gzhan dang skal pa mi mnyam zhing / /mkhan chen chos rgyal bas ༈ snying po chen po'i bde drod rab 'bar na/ /zhes so/ /tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan zhing / dbang rgyud man ngag phyin ci ma log pa thob cing / thugs su chud nas ston pa bla ma'i sku'i cha thams cad kyi pad+mo la rang gi yan lag kun gyi mchog spyi bos 'dud pas lus dang / gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs kyi bstod pas ngag dang / dad cing gus pa bskyed pas yid de/ gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od srungs nye bar 'khor dang kun dga' bos/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bla gos khri steng nas/ /nyam thag dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag thos zhes/ /ston pa'i mdzad tshul gus pas brjod pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ni/ ston pa'i nyan thos brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang nas sbyangs pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa 'od srungs dang / nye bar 'khor dang kun dga' bos ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ bstan 'dzin dgra bcom pa lnga brgyar gcig gi ma tshang pa bsdus nas/ de dag gi bla gos kyi khri steng nas ston pa'i yon tan dran nas/ nyam thag pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la zhes sogs kyi sgo nas/ ston pas dang por byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/

tha mar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshul mngon pa/ 'dul ba/ mdo sde'i sde snod rin po che'i rnam pa gsum legs par bsdus pa bzhin du/ bka' drin 'khor med chos rje rin po che/ /mthong ba'i skabs med dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /nyin mtshan bsams kyang yon tan mtha' ma rtogs/ /'chi ba cha tsam gus pas brjod bgyid na/ /zhes pa ni bdag sogs gdul bya rnams la yang dag pa'i lam bstan pa'i bka' drin 'khor ba med pa'i chos kyi rje de nyid mig shes kyis mngon sum du mthong ba'i skal ba med cing / yid shes kyis dran pa'i yul 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/ nyin mtshan du gus pas bsams kyang lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi pha mtha' rtogs par mi nus te/ bstod par/ bshes gnyen mkha' lding dbang po rnams kyis kyang / /khyod kyi yon tan mtha' ma mthong ba na/ /gang gi blo gros phye ma leb lta bus/ /de ni dpog par nus pa ga la yod/ /ces so/ /de lta na'ang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par mthong zhing thos pa'i yon tan cha'i cha tsam sgro 'dogs pa dang / lcam bu spang nas gus pas brjod par bgyis na thub bstan nub khar dar zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bstan pa'i 'jug 'dir skyes chen khyod byon nas/ /lta spyod nyams len rnam dag spel la dgongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni mdo las/ mar me 'chi khar gsal ba ltar/ /nga yi bstan pa nub khar dar/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i dgongs pa yin/ yang rnyigs bstan pa'i 'jug 'dir mkhas shing grub pa mnyes pa'i skyes chen khyed byon nas/ lta ba dang spyod pa nyams len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa la dgongs pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas pa'i dbang po mang du byon na yang / 'ga' zhig gis lta ba'i cha de kho na gsal bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig gis spyod pa'i phyogs de kho na gsal bar mdzad/

'ga' zhig gis nyams len gyi cha kho na gsal bar mdzad pa tsam du zad/ bshad sgrub gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa khyod las gzhan sngar ma byung bar mthong zhing thos pas khums/ phyis kyang mi 'byung ste/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las/ mang pos bkur bas chen por grags rnams kyang / /rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa lhur byed kyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ched cher mi 'dzin na/ /'di na thub bstan gces 'dzin dam pa su/ /mkhas rlom phal cher smra mkhan ne tso bzhin/ /tshig gi rjes 'brang gzhu tsam klog par zad/ /rigs dang mi rigs 'byed la thom gyur na/ /'di na rigs ldan legs bshad smra ba gang / /nyin dang mtshan du rnal 'byor bsgoms rnams kyang / /lhag spyod kyis ni ting 'dzin sgom pa bzhin/ /yang dag lta ba'i gnad kyis dben gyur na/ /'di na yang dag lam zhugs sgrub po med/ /lto phyir rab byung gral phyir bsnyen rdzogs kyang / /tshul ldan bslab la gus pa'i dge sbyong nyung / /kye ma kye hun shākya'i bstan pa ni/ /ming tsam lus par kho bo gcig pus mthong / /zhes dang / blo bzang bstod par/ klu sgrub thog med gnyis ni bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud nas brtse ba yis/ /skyon bral gsung gi legs bshad legs 'doms pas/ /bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa ster ba 'di/ /khyod kyi rjes su bstan las gzhan su zhig /ces so/ /bsams bzhin srid bzhes chos ldan rigs su 'khrungs/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs yongs 'dzin mkhas mang bsten/ /sdom pa gsum blangs srog pas gces par bzung / /thub pa'i ring lugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di/ bdag nyid chen po 'di sku tshe snga mar kha cher paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas/ chos rje blo bzang grags pa paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti bha trar gyur pas gtso mdzad gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa la chos sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi'i spyi don phyin ci ma log par bstan nas/

bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad tshul/ gsang bdag gis phyag rdor grub thob la gsungs pa yin/ de nas bsams bzhin du gangs ri'i khro 'dir lta spyod nyams len phyin ci log tu spyod pa rnams tshar bcad pa'i phyir/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya dang nye ba na/ red mda' khab sor grags pa der/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgom po'i nang blon/ blon po mgar stongs btsan yul srungs kyi brgyud pa/ yab red mda'i blon chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / yum lhag bsam rnam par dag pa bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims dang tshul mtshungs pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su gyur te/ lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe yum la nyi zla shar ba dang sgron me spar ba dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la sogs rmi ltas bzang po mang po byung zhing / lus sdug bsngal dang bral/ sems bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /btsas pa'i tshe na yang / yum sras gnyis ka la btsa' ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur to/ /bstod par/ khyod ni lum bha'i nags su rgyal ba bzhin/ /dri med yum gyi lhums nas bltams pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams phun tshogs khyod sku ma bzung phyir/ /tshangs dbang nyid du gyur ram yang na shi/ /zhes so/ /de nas 'o ma dang zho dang / mar gyi nying khu sogs kyis bskyed bsring ste mtshan yang rje btsun zhes bya bar gsol to/ /smra shes don go tshun chad dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra thos pa'am rten mthong ba na dad cing gus pa cher skye bar byung / yab yum gnyis ka gzhon nu'i dus nas 'das shing / a ne mtshan ldan gyi mkha' 'gro ma bkra shis 'bum zhes bya bas gzhon nu nyid nas mkhas pa'i dbang po chen por gyur gyi bar du zhabs tog skyo ngal med par phul bas/ drin shin tu che gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di byis pa'i dus su/ a ne la/ nga yang na sa skya dpon chen gyi lag rtags blangs nas bod khams bde ba la 'god/

yang na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas bstan pa nyi mo ltar gsal bar byed gsungs pas/ a ne na re/ rje btsun blo bo che/ khyod kyis de gnyis ga mi 'grub par 'dug gi ham pa ma che zer/ de dus mtshan yang rje btsun blo bo che grags pa byung / de dus 'phags chen chos bzang dpal ba la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa sogs thugs rje chen po'i chos bskor mang du zhus/ de nas bdag nyid chen po'i thugs la/ dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir bstan pa'i sgor 'jug dgongs nas/ gangs can gyi ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan dam par gyur pa/ sa bzangs paṇa chen pa'i drung du/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa dgung lo bco brgyad pa la nos/ mtshan yang gzhon nu blo gros zhes gsol/ de nas shes bya'i gnas thams cad la 'jug par byed pa'i sgo/ bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel la gzigs par dgongs nas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon kun dga' dang / lung rigs smra ba'i dbang po mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel gnyis kyi zhabs la btug ste/ blo gros sbyangs pas/ rnam 'grel la go ba tho re ba chags nas/ grwa bskor mdzad pas/ thugs rab che ba'i grags pa thob/ de dus rgyal ba'i sras po thog med bzang po dpal ba'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yo zhing / mig nas mchi ma 'dzag pa sogs byung ste/ dngul chu'i chos rdzong du byon te/ sems dpa' chen po'i drung du smon 'jug sems bskyed blangs/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong la sogs pa'i chos bskor mang du zhus/ de nas gdan sar byon nas/ chos khri thang du lan 'debs gcig mdzad pas/ gzhung la sbyor ba bde sang ba gcig ma 'khod pa/ grwa bskor bas ma shes na'ang / khong pa rang la rang gis thugs shin tu khrel ba gcig byung nas/ rnam 'grel gyi gzhung kho rang ci zer shes pa gcig ma byung na/

slob dpon gyi ngag rgyun gyis bslu bar 'dug dgongs nas/ sa skyar dpe mtshams bcad/ gzhung la brgya cher bcug sde bdun mdo 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa gzigs/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i legs bshad rnams la'ang gzigs/ slob dpon che chung gnyis la chos mang du gsan pas/ sde bdun dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud nas/ mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab par gyur te/ rnam 'grel la 'grel pa che chung gnyis spyi don dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ gang gi legs bshad tsha zer phra mos kyang / /mkhas rlom me khyer bye ba'i gzi 'phrogs cing / /rigs tshul 'bum phrag stong gi zer 'phro ba'i/ /blo gros 'di ni sngon med nyi ma yin/ /kun gzhi'i mngal nas thon pa'i sa bon rnams/ /shes rab yum gyi legs bskrun brtson 'grus kyi/ /ma mas rgyun du bskyangs pas gangs can 'di/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i gdung 'tshob kho bo 'khrungs/ /de lta na yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /mkhas rmongs 'byed pa'i tshul la mi mkhas pa'i/ /nya ba'i lag tu rin chen 'grim pa ltar/ /blo ngan 'tshong bu'i tshogs dang mnyam du spel/ /bsgrubs dang sun 'byin rigs pa'i mche sder gyis/ /phas rgol glang po'i klad pa 'gems nus kyang / /legs nyes 'byed pa'i gzu bos dben pas na/ /smra ngan wa skyes tshogs kyang rtag tu rgol/ /ces gsungs shing bstod par/ rigs tshul brgya phrag du ma'i ro ldan pa'i/ /blo chen ldan rnams dga' ba bskyed byed pa/ /rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i thun mong min pa'i lugs/ /yongs su rdzogs par smra ba khyod du bas/ /zhes dang / /sde bdun ral pa 'thug pos gnya' khebs cing / /mdo yi stobs rgyas 'grel bshad so so'i khyogs/ /nyid kyi shes rab ngan pa'i glang 'phen pa/ /tshad ma ri bo'i sul na rgyu ba lags/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des/

mngon par rtog pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i gsung mngon par rtog pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa la gzigs par dgongs nas/ phar phyin gyi gzhung spar ma gcig dbu sngas su bcug ste gzim pa'i mtshan lam du rgya gar skad nas rdzogs so'o bar gzhung ma lus pa 'bur du dod pa phyag gis gzung nyan pa byung / re re nas blangs nas zhal du gsol bas/ ro mchog dang ldan pa 'byung zhing / mnal sad pa dang shin tu dgyes par gyur nas/ de ring ji tsam zin lta dgongs nas bzung bas/ bam po che ba 'phyi la zin pa byung gsungs/ gzhung thugs su chud pa dang / lung chos kyi go ba cha pe chags pa byung na yang / shin tu mkhas pa gcig byed dgongs nas skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las gsan cing / khyad par du nyi khri snang ba dang brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa rgya 'grel rnams dang / 'gre ar gyi 'grel bshad la sogs bod 'grel rnams la gzigs pas/ 'phags seng gnyis kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud nas phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka sbyor ṭīka don bdun cu rnams mdzad de/ tshig gi rjes 'brang byis pa'i blo can rnams/ /sngon rabs bshad srol bzlas pas mgu na yang / /'bras med spun pa 'phyar ba ngal mthong nas/ /gzhan zer rnam grangs zlos pa kho bos spangs/ /spyi don gzhung brgya'i tshul dang mi 'gal zhing / /tshig don dngos stobs rig pas bsgrub pa la/ /mkhas rlom mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyis/ /yun ring brtags kyang kun dga'i skabs med do/ /zhes gsungs/ gon byo nyi mas bstod par/ 'phags pa'i bzhed gzhung ma lus gzhan dag kyang / /lan re tsam gyis ma lus mthar phyin phyir/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol son pa'i go 'phangs mnyes pa yin/

/zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po de chos thams cad kyi ma mo mngon pa'i sde snod la gzigs par dgongs nas/ gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs la btug ste/ mngon pa gong 'og tshar mang du gsan cing / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga/ bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam gnyis/ pra ka ra sde brgyad 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa la gzigs shing / mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo tsā ba blo gros bstan pa'i 'grel bshad la gzigs pas/ thogs med sku mched kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud nas/ mngon pa gong 'og gi ṭīk+ka bsdus don dang bcas pa mdzad de/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang po mkha' la spyod pa'i mtshan ma rjes su mthong gyur nas/ /'dab ma shin tu rgyas pa min pa'ang de yi rjes su slob pa ltar/ /blo gros stobs ldan sngon rab mkhas pa'i rjes su 'brang nas bshad pa la/ /phra dog sgo nas smod par byed kyang 'di la nyes pa cung zad med/ /ces gsungs/ blo bstod par/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i ring lugs la/ /rnam rig shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /gang phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung 'tshob pa/ /thogs med sku mched gnyis kyi bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud pa'ang khyod du bas/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des/ bstan pa'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa nod nas/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya phyin ci ma log par nyams su len pa'i srol btod dgongs nas/ gnas brtan dgra bcom pa chen po/ ldog lhod pa mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang po'i drung du byon nas mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa nod nas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa tshar gcig gsan pas/ mkhan chen pa la yang thugs bskyed thon pa byung / lta khrid kyang zhus/ chos grol ba dang / mkhan chen pas ja bur gcig gnang nas/ khyed skyes stobs kyi thugs rab che zhing /

gzhung lugs gzhan la sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis 'dul ba la yang nged pas khyed shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung gda'o/ /chos bdag po la 'phrod lags so/ /'di la khyed kyis ṭīk+ka gcig mdzod/ bstod 'dul gyi sdom rgyud 'di ma chad pa gcig 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i zhal lta bzang po gnang ba dang du blang ste 'dul ba lung dang rgya 'grel rnams dang / bya khyi sog gsum sogs bod kyi 'grel bshad rnams la gzigs pas/ yon shāka rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud cing / mdo rtsa'i ṭīk+ka dang las tshogs gnyis mdzad nas/ de phyin chad 'chad nyan mdzad dus kyang / dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong dgag dbye sogs ma chag par mdzad do/ /yon tan 'od ces sa gsum rab grags pa/ /rgyal ba'i rang lugs 'dzin pa des mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba 'bum sde'i don/ /ma lus bsdud byed legs bshad 'di byas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bstod par/ thub pas lan gcig min par bsngags pa yi/ /tshul khrims 'phags pa'i nor bu gzigs nas ni/ /nyer sbas zla ba'i nor bu yon tan 'od/ /thams cad yod smra mkhas pa'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /'dul ba 'bum sde'i dgag bsgrub gnang gsum gyi/ /bslab pa'i gnas la mkhas shing 'da' mi byed/ /ces so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des/ snying po'i don gtso bor ston pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal mnga' nas mdzad pa/ dbu ma rig pa'i tshogs la gzigs par bzhed na'ang / de dus su gangs ri'i khrod na bka' ma chad tsam ma gtog pa 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa dang / sgom sgrub kyis nyams su len pa'i srol nyams par gyur nas/ thugs shin tu chad par gyur kyang / bshad pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la zhu dgongs na'ang / dbus na bzhugs pas ma byung par/ chos rje byang sems pa la rigs tshogs bzhi brgya pa/ 'jug pa sogs dbu ma'i bskor rnams gsan nas/ dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab/ thugs rab kyis yang yang dpyad pas/

sngon gyi smon lam dang / sbyangs pa'i mthu dang / dkon mchog gi byin rlabs la brten nas klu sgrub yab sras dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud cing / mkhas pa chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / rang rgyud bshad gsum gyi gzhung lugs rnams kyang ma 'dres par mkhyen nas/ 'chad nyan gyis legs par gtan la phab/ de dus su slob ma rnams kyis rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs gal che ba rnams la yig cha 'jog par mdzad par zhu zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum tshig gsal gyi stong thun gyi 'grel pa rnams mdzad nas/ slob dpon thams cad kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan gyi srol legs par gtod pa'i mthu la brten nas/ de'i dus su chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan zhang dbon/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal khu dbon/ mkhas pa chen po g.yag sprug pa sangs rgyas dpal dpon slob rnams kyis kyang dbu ma la 'chad nyan mdzad pa/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir dbu ma'i bshad srol dar zhing rgyas par gyur kyang phal cher rang rgyud kyi lta ba'i thog na gnas shing / thal 'gyur gyi lta ba thugs su chud pa tsam ma 'byung 'dug ste/ 'di tsam yang dga' mo yin/ nga dang por slob gnyer byed dus/ sa skya sogs na dbu ma'i dpe cha gcig 'dug zer nas/ nor mi cher byed pa 'dug ding sang dbu ma'i dpe cha la rtsis su byed pa 'di yang kho bos bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin gsungs/ karma pa dkon gzhon gyi gsung gis ding sang gangs ri'i khrod na mkhas pa dang / blun po kun dga'/ dbu ma sna/ dbu ma kha zer ba 'di red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de gong du thang sag na dbu ma shi ro gcig 'dug zer/ gzhan yod pa'i lab ma tshor gsungs/ rgya gar bal po bod kyi yul rnams su/ /mdo don smra ba'i mkhas pa mang byon yang / /phal cher rtog pas sbyar ba'i don tsam la/ /mkhas par zad kyi de nyid don la min/

/thub pa'i bstan la nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /'khrul med smra ba 'phags pa klu sgrub yin/ /de yi bzhed gzhung rab dkar kun+da'i tshal/ /de bzhin 'byed mkhas dpal ldan zla ba yin/ /slob dpon de dag dgongs pa 'di yin zhing / /mkhas rlom mang yang su la ci cha yod/ /rnam bkra tshon gyi ri mo gsal ba yi/ /rnam dbye dmus long rnams la yod dam ci/ /long pas rin chen gter kha phyed pa ltar/ /rnam dag 'phags pa'i mig dang mi ldan yang / /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi byin brlabs las/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i don 'di kho bos rnyed/ /ces gsungs/ bstod par/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i ring lugs pa/ /mtha' bral shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /gang gis bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung tshob pa/ /klu sgrub zla grags gnyis kyi bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud pa'ang khyed du bas/ /ces so/ /mthar lta'i g.yang sa ring du spangs gyur la/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rnams kyi bgrod pa'i shul/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba/ /dbu ma'i lam nas khyod ni gshegs pa lags/ /zhes dang / rnyigs ma'i dus 'dir ngan rtog chang gis myos gyur pas/ /de nyid don la skye bo rnams ni 'khrug pa'i tshe/ /gang gis spros kun gsal nas stong nyid zab mo'i don/ /yang dag legs rtog rnam dpyod 'di ni e ma mtshar/ /zhes so/ /de na bdag nyid chen po des theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par dgongs nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po byang chub rtse mo'i drung du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa'i dbang 'ga' zhus/ gsang mtshan yang mi bskyod rdo rjer gsol/ rgyud lo tsā ba nem bzang pa la zhus/ man ngag chos kyi rje grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du zhus/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs pa'i dbang 'ga' zhus/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po la rgyud kyi bshad pa zhus/

bla ma dpal ldan pa'i drung du lam 'bras man ngag chos skyong che chung gi bskor dang bcas pa zhus/ sa bzangs paṇa chen pa'i drung du/ bde mchog sogs dbang 'ga' zhus/ chos rje skyabs mchog pa'i drung du rdo rje phreng ba/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sa skya pa'i pha chos rdo rje gzhon nu sogs mang du zhus/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga mdor byas/ 'phags pa lhas byas pa'i spyod bsdus sgrol me/ dpal ldan zla bas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus sgron gsal la sogs pa 'phags lugs kyi rgya 'grel thams cad dang / rgyal po in+t+ra bho dhi la sogs gsang 'dus snga srol ba rnams kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i bshad byang snyems pa'i me tog dang / ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po/ mar me mdzad kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog bzhi brgya pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ tha ga na'i 'grel par/ rgyal bas byin gyi 'grel pa la sogs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gsum gyi rgya 'grel rnams dang / bod kyi rje 'gos gdog klan gsum dang / sa skya pa khu dbon/ rin po che bu ston pa la sogs pa'i legs bshad rnams la yang dag par gzigs rtog mdzad pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud nas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur te/ gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ mngon rtogs/ bdag 'jug mchod phreng / rim lnga'i bsdus don la sogs pa mdzad nas/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i man ngag bshad rgyud gzhan gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /'dus pa'i rgyud chen rim pa lngar/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bshad/ /sngon rabs rgyud pa'i man ngag dang / /phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyud don bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhir/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhi bas phye/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag gi /rgyud don bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /

/rdzogs rim thig le rnam gsum du/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bstan/ /'phags dang mkhas pas gsal byas pa'i/ /'dus pa'i rgyud chen shing rta'i srol/ /rim pa gsum du phyed pa'i don/ /rnyed pa gang de ya mtshan no/ /zhes gsungs/ bstod par/ thub pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ /ji snyed gsung pa chos kyi rtser gyur pa/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas btab rdo rje'i tshig /ji bzhin legs par phye nas rim gnyis kyi/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi bde la rol bas na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes pa'i sgra de yang / /mgon po khyod la don dang bcas par 'jug /ces so/ /gong du bstan pa'i bla ma de rnams gus pas bsten pa yin te/ skyes dgu'i gtsug rgyan chos rje bsod rgyal dang / /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po'i dpal/ /ma ti paṇa chen mkhan chen byang rtse dang / /mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon kun dga' sogs/ /bka' drin nod pa'i bla ma bcu phrag gnyis/ /yun ring 'bad de gus pa'i tshul gyis bsten/ /zhes so/ /gong du bstan pa'i so thar byang sems rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa gsum yan lag dang bcas pa sku srog pas kyang gces par bsrungs pa yin te/ kho bo sangs rgyas bstan la rab byung nas/ /rigs dang mi rigs 'byed shes tshun chod du/ /lus ngag yid kyis spyod pa ci byed kyang / /rab tu bsgrims te thub pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs/ /thog med gom pa'i nyon mongs shugs drag pas/ /gal te mi rigs cung zad byas na yang / /de yi mod la dug zos dran pa bzhin/ /'gyod sems dran pas slar yang chos bzhin byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bstod par/ gzhan dag khas len chu yi ri mo bzhin/ /mang po nyid kyang 'phral du yal ba bgyid/ 'dir ma dper tshig rkang zhig chad pa 'dra/ /shi yang dam bca' gzhan du bgyid ma lags/ /zhes so/ /bdag nyid chen po de nyid ni thub pa'i ring lugs pa bla na med pa yin te/

nyams len byin rlabs kyi rgyud par rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste/ bcu dgu pa la byon cing / zab mo lta ba'i rgyud par thub pa chen po nas bzung ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la byon la/ rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyud par thub pa chen po nas bzung ste/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la byon/ rgyud pa gsum ka'i bka' rgyud bsgrub rgyud dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin no/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun la legs sbyangs nas/ /rtag chad mthar lta'i grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /rnam gzhag lung dang dngos stobs rigs pas bshig /log smra tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni gong du bshad pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag la legs par sbyangs pa yin te/ rgya gar nas 'gyur bstan bcos thams dang / /mdo dang rgyud sde phal cher legs par bltas/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i de nyid 'byed pa la/ /mkhas mang mdun sar 'jigs med spobs pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di/ dang po nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin pe che la mos pa gcig yod na'ang / slob dpon rang grogs mched sogs kyi stobs kyis kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' la 'dris che ba gcig byung nas/ jo nang gi grub mtha'i rgyab brten/ rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo/ mdo mya ngan las 'das pa chen po/ dgong pa nges 'grel/ lang kar gshegs pa/ bstan bcos rgyud bla/ chos dbyings bstod pa sogs la brten par dgongs nas/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par blangs nas jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 'di ting tshugs pa gcig byed dgongs nas/ man mun grags khar byon nas/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag la gzigs rtog tshar gsum mdzad pas/ dang po la jo nang pa'i grub mtha' mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'di dag gi dgongs pa yin nges par 'dug dgongs pa byung / gnyis pa la yin min the tshom za ba gcig byung / gsum pa la dgongs pa las phyin ci log tu go ba gcig byung gsung /

de nas gdan sar mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung du byon nas/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 'di mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'di dag gi dgongs pa yin bsam nas/ lta rtog zhib tu bgyis na/ dgongs pa las phyi rol du gyur gda' lags zhus pas/ khyod mkhas drag pas shin tu bden gsungs nas ca ra mdzad pa byung / de dus de ston pa la spring yig mdzad pas/ mkhan chen pa shin tu ma mnyes te/ 'khon 'dzin mdzad pa byung / de nas bdag nyid chen po'i thugs la mkhan chen nya dbon pa 'di thugs rab che zhing / tshad ma'i rigs pa la shin tu mkhas pa'i stobs kyis 'di la lung rigs kyi dgag bsgrub zhus na 'gyur bar nges/ khong pa 'gyur na chu 'ol kha nas 'gyur nas ding sang gi jo nang pa thams cad 'gyur ba gcig 'ong bar 'dug dgongs/ brtse chen du nya dbon po'i drung du byon pas/ skyo ma snga btsan du song nas/ dngos su mi skyon yang / thugs mi mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston gyi 'dug pas/ da zhus kyang don du mi 'gyur bar 'dug dgongs te/ gdan sar log byon nas/ bstan 'dzin rnams la spring yig nor bu phreng ba mdzad pas/ gangs ri'i khrod na dus 'khor bar khas 'ches pa rnams dang / khyad par du jo nang pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dngos su rtsod par mi nus kyang / lkog tu rgyud cher 'khrug par gyur to/ /de'i dus su drung bzhi thog pas gtso mdzad gdan sa chen po'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnams 'dzoms pa'i drung du/ bdag nyid chen pos dus 'khor la 'gal 'du yod gsungs/ karma pa dkon gzhon pa 'gal 'du med gsung nas rtsod pa'i skabs su/ karma pa na re/ shes bya chos can/ pad+ma dkar po blun por thal/ blun po bdag spyod 'dod ces pa de sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung 'khrul med yin pa'i phyir/ gsal khyab khas blangs/ rtags grub ste/ rgyud 'brel dri med 'od kyi rang lugs kyi tshig yin pa'i phyir zer ba la/

bdag nyid chen pos/ shes bya chos can/ sgra rtag mi rtag rtsod pa'i skabs su/ sgra mi rtag pa'i sgrub byed du thal/ rgyud 'grel dri med 'od nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung yin min rtsod pa'i skabs su/ rgyud 'grel dri med 'od kyi rang lugs kyi tshig yin pa de/ rgyud 'grel de nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung yin pa'i sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir zhes gsung nas sun phyung zhing / gzhan yang bla ma shar chung pa la sogs pas yi ger bkod nas rtsod pa 'byung ba rnams kyang / sgrub byed bsgrub bya dang mtshungs pa las ma byung gsung / jo nang pa'i phyogs kyi sngags pa gcig gis khyed mkhas pa chen po yin pa la/ dus 'khor la dgag pa mdzad par mi 'os zhus pas/ de'i lan du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /dgag sgrub mkhas pa rnams kyis byed/ /mi rnams 'phying pa 'dra ba la/ /phyi la col gnyer ci zhig yod/ /ces gsungs/ de'i dus su mkhan chen bstan rgyal bas gtso mdzad/ jo nang pa rnams gros byas nas/ kho 'di zer na rang re 'di zer gyi lung rig mang du brtsams nas/ 'jam dbyangs chen po la slob dpon gzhon blo ba 'di spyan drongs/ bde gshegs snying po drang nges la rtsod pa yin zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams sa skya nas spyan drangs rtsod pa'i skabs su/ bdag nyid chen pos 'o kol rtsod pa byed na/ yang na rgyud/ yang na mdo/ yang na bstan bcos kho na'i steng nas byed/ blun po mgu ba'i rtsod pa sras ta bsre te mi byed gsung zhing 'jam dbyangs pas kyang de bzhin 'thad zhus pas/ khong gis lkog gros byas pa'i lung rigs rnams zhig nas/ dri bcas dang dri med kyi de bzhin nyid la khyad med cing / stobs sogs 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i bde gshegs snying po don dam par grub par khas blangs pa la/ bdag nyid chen pos/ shes bya chos can/ rtag brtan gyi bde gshegs snying po bden par ma grub par thal/

de don dam par gcig tu'ang ma grub/ du mar yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ bsal ba khas blangs/ rtags ma grub na/ gcig tu grub na du ma la khyab pa bud/ du mar grub na gcig yin pa bud/ gzhan yang / shes bya chos can/ bde gshegs snying po bden 'dzin gyi blo spang du mi rung bar thal/ de bden par grub pa'i phyir gsungs pa la/ slob dpon blo gros rdo rjes/ shes bya chos can/ spros bral du 'dzin pa'i blo spang du mi rung bar thal/ spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum khas blangs zer ba la/ de 'dra tshig 'dra tsam yin snying po med gsungs/ de dag la sogs pa'i lung rigs du mas jo nang pa'i grub mtha' la sngar zhugs pa log pa dang / the tshom za ba dang / phyis mi 'jug pa'i 'phrin las mdzad do/ /bdag nyid chen pos dus 'khor chos min gsung bar gangs can du grags na'ang / sgra ji bzhin pa la nang 'gal yod gsung pa las/ chos min zhes ma gsungs te/ rtsod par/ 'on kyang 'phags pas mdzad dam min kyang sla/ /legs par bshad pa'ang mang du mthong bas na/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngog ma yin zhes/ /kho bo 'di la mtha' gcig bkur mi 'debs/ /zhes dang / 'gal spong du/ ding sang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas rlom rnams/ /ldem po'i ngag gis zab mo'i tshul ston pa/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa'i/ /tshig la ji bzhin smra ru mngon zhen pas/ /rnam gzhag mdo rgyud tshogs dang 'gal ba yi/ /log pa'i chos lugs mang du spel mthong nas/ /'khyog po'i shing la srong ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /rgal zhing brtag pa'i sgo nas bdag gis bris/ /zhes dang / nges don gsal byed du/ 'di don 'grel byed mkhas pa gzhan dag gis/ /snying po dor nas sbun pa yang yang phyar/ /rgya mtsho srubs las bdud rtsi ji bzhin du/ /yang dag don gyi snying po kho bos blangs/ /'dab brgya'i tshal nas sbrang rtsi bung bas len/ /chu dang 'o ma ngang pas so sor 'byed/ sngon 'jig rten chags pa'i tshe/

lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyis ri rab la srubs shing byas/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas la bsrub thag byas nas/ rgya mtsho bsrub pa la/ bdud rtsi bum pa gang dang / dug ha la bum pa gang dang / zla ba phyed pa gcig dang gsum byung / de'i tshe bdud rtsi lha rnams kyis khyer/ dug dbang phyug gis mthung pas mgrin pa nag por song / zla ba phyed pa lha'i dbang po'i gtsug rgyan byed ces grags/ de bzhin du dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i dug 'ga' zhig jo nang pas gsol/ drang don gyi zla ba phyed pa mkhasapa zha lu ba gzhan gyis byis pa rnams dga' ba'i rgyan du byas/ nges don gyi bdud rtsi kho bos blangs so/ /nor bu 'ching bu ded dpon mkhas pas shes/ /legs bshad nyes bshad mkhas pa'i blo yis rtogs/ /yod pa'i legs bshad phrag dog mun pas sgrib/ /med pa'i skyon rnams blo ngan mig gis mthong / /gdug pa'i sbrul gyis 'o ma 'thung ba bzhin/ /legs bshad bdud rtsis nyon mongs dug 'phel ba'i/ /log pa'i rgyun phyogs gzhol ba'i blo ngan rnams/ /legs bshad chu lon stong gis mi ldog med/ /gzur gnas blo ldan 'ga' yis 'di mthong na/ /yid la 'bab 'gyur snyam nas ngas 'di sbyar/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa dang mthun na ga la 'geg chos sku rtag brtan ther zug tu 'dod pa sngar rgya bod bal gsum gang du'ang ma byung zhing / da yang lta ba ngan pa la 'jug pa rgyud bcad pa'i phyir dgag pa mdzad de/ dge legs sa bon yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /yang dag lta ba'i nor mchog 'phrog byed cing / /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod par byed pa yi/ /lta ngan las lhag phung byed dgra gzhan med/ /lta ngan dman pa'i thad la mngon zhen cing / /rtag chad mthar lta'i wa skad cher sgrog pa/ /'di dag ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang na yang / /thub pa'i bstan la mu stegs than skyel yin/

/zhes gsungs/ de dus jo nang pa'i pho rus pa gcig gis ldog na yar yongs pas/ mkhas pa gzhon blo dpon slob rnams 'byon gyi 'dug zer ba thos nas/ jo nang pa la nga mi gcig la yod med med/ kho sod na jo nang pa'i dgra sgo chog pa 'dug bsams nas/ dbu la rdo rdeg pa'i dam bca' byas yongs/ drung pa dang 'jal bas lus rengs/ sems dran pa nyams nas brdeg pa ma byung / kho dran pa rnyed pa dang / dge bshes gzil can gcig 'dug snyam pa byung / dus phyis drung pa la dad nas mthol bshag kyang phul bar grags so/ /bzang ldan du ka bcu pa yon tan gyis/ jo nang pa la bka' skyon mdzad pa 'di la/ sdig pa chen po yong pa 'dra zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung nas/ 'di 'dra zer ba shin tu mang ste de 'dra ga la yin/ sngon 'jig rten du ston pa byon pa'i dus su lhas byin la sogs pa'i bdud rigs rnams dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la sogs rnams la zhe sdang dang khong khro dpag tu med pa skyes pa'i sdig pa ston pa la yong ngam/ de'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs byon pa la nag phyogs rnams mi dga' bar gyur pa'i sdig pa'ang de dag la 'ong ngam/ khyad par du 'phags pa klu sgrub byon nas theg pa chen po'i srol phye ba la/ rang sde gnyis kas theg chen ni bka' min zhes/ skur pa btab pa'i sdig pa yang bdag nyid chen po la 'ong ngam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe/ 'byung po'i bya rnams long ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin cing / gnam thig drang por rgyab na sgur po ras su 'thon pa lugs yin/ blun po'i lab de 'dra ba ma zer gsungs/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byon pa dang / /mkhas rnams bshad pa byed pa la/ /'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi lugs yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis chos bshad na/ /chos log spyod pa pham byed cing /

/bdud rigs thams cad yi mug 'gyur/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di 'dras bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /ces so/ /lta tshe chos sku rtag brtan 'dod/ /sgom tshe ci snang chos skur spyod/ /chos sku rgyud ldan lus can kun/ /las kyi 'khor bar 'khyam par 'tshang / /mkhan chen g.yag pas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya/ 'khor ba la zad pa med gsungs pa la bdag nyid chen pos/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya bar tshad mas nges par thal/ der tshad mas grub pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pas/ g.yag pas khyab pa ma grub gsungs nas tshur ldog pas/ rtags ma grub la sogs pa'i 'phen len mang du mdzad na'ang / don la ston pa mkhas pa rnams bdag nyid chen po'i rig pa la mnyes shing / tshig la ston pa'i mkhas pa rnams mkhan chen g.yag pa'i rig pa la mnyes par grags so/ /chos rje lo tsā ba dang / karma pa dkon gzhon gnyis kun rdzob tu yod pas yod pa'i go chod mi chod la rtsod pa mdzad pas/ rtsod pa 'grel mo byung / pang lo tsā ba'i gsung nas don brtsod ni mi yongs bar 'dug tshig la snying po med pas/ drung pa rnams 'o brgyal/ gzhan rnams thugs dam chags pas bzhud gsung / de nas bdag nyid chen pos/ drung pa 'o brgyal bdag gis brtsod pas chog gsungs nas thal 'gyur 'ga' 'phangs pas/ karma pa la zug par thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub/ drung gi gsung nas/ dbus gtsang gi dge bshes chen por grags pa rnams kyang / don rgyab 'gal song yang tshig phyogs tsam 'grig na/ rang re brtsod rgyu med/ grub mtha' mthun ces smra/ don gcig kyang tshig cung zad mi mthun na mgo byang mthug tu song song brtsod kyin 'dug ste de 'dra la snying po med/ drung lo tsā ba yang / rigs pas ma dpyad par kun rdzob tu yod pas yod pa'i go mi chod ni mi gsung / gsungs na chad ltar 'gyur/ karma pa yang rigs pas dpyad nas kyang kun rdzob tu yod na yod pas go chod par mi 'dod/

'dod na rtag ltar 'gyur/ gzhong stong la khyi 'thab mi dgos par gda' gsung / de dus nyan mkhan rnams na re/ bla ma'i zhabs tog tu 'gro ba/ rang gi blo gros kyi nus pa thon pa/ ngo mtshar che zhes shin tu dad par gyur to/ /stag lung lo tsā ba shākya bzang gis bka' bzhi pa gcig btang nas/ nged rgyan drug gi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dod pa yin/ khyed ji ltar 'dod zhus pas/ de la nges pa med/ gcig pa rnams ni gcig mi gcig pa rnams ni mi gcig par byas pas 'ong gsung / khong na re/ khyed mkhas pa chen po lags pas/ thag chod pa'i zhal lta gnang dgos zhes nan gyis zhus pas/ dgongs pa e gcig mi gcig 'di la shes mod/ klu sgrub yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pas thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs 'geg par 'dug thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pas/ klu sgrub yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs 'geg par 'dug de la thugs sam btang pas shes/ lar dbu ma pa dang dngos smra ba gnyis grub mtha' gcig na/ dgongs pa mi gcig pa bya ba su yod pa yin/ zhes gad mo cher mdzod/ slob dpon bka' bcu pa dar ma yid ches 'bras rtag bla ma rin po che pa'i de dngos yin par gda' lags zhus pas/ khyed kyi de da dung skyor dang gsung bskyar bas/ grub mtha' de bzung na/ kha nag sbabs 'gro bar gsung / khong gi 'gro bar gyur gcig ces gsung nas/ smon lam 'debs na sku dbang che/ rigs pas ldog mi btub zhus pas/ 'o na dgug cig gsungs nas/ thal 'gyur gcig 'phangs pas/ 'khor gsum dngos 'gal du song / lo zla bar bsam bsam pa tsho skad cig re la khur rgyugs gsung / de dus dbus pa'i dge bshes kun na re/ blo bzang ba 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs gar gshegs su dpe cha mdzo rgyab che chung bzhi bkal nas nyin mtshan med par gzigs pa'i grub mtha' skyor bzang po dar ma lta bus skyar ba la skad cig ma la bshigs gtong pas/

'jigs su rung zhes ha las par gyur to/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras chen la sogs pa sngon gyi phyag chen pa 'ga' yis sku tshe snga ma yang dang yang du sbyangs shing / sku tshe 'dir yang rlung sems dbang du 'dus te/ gang byung 'dis chog na ci byas kyang sla ba rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa la 'khrul gzhi byas te/ ding sang gi phyag chen par bsgom pa phal mo che rnams ni lhag par tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gces spras su mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams kyi lugs/ nyan thos kyi lugs yin zhes khyad du bsad nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin zhes tshig tu smra yang / don la bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gnyen por cung zad kyang mi 'gro ba 'di dag ni chad par lta ba yin te/ lta bas spyod pa khyad med du bsad nas/ bag med pa'i spyod pa la lhur len pa las chad par lta ba gzhan med/ 'di dag ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas gnas lugs kyi don bsgom pa rtog sgom skyon can du byed cing / yid la byed pa thams cad bkag ste/ mi rtog pa thom po sgom pa la skyon med kyi sgom du byed par gnang ste/ lugs 'di ni bstan pa las phyi rol du gyur pa ting 'dzin rgyal po las gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa dag ting 'dzin sgom byed kyang / /de ni bdag tu 'dzin pa bzhig mi nus/ /des ni nyon mongs ches cher rab tu 'khrugs/ /lhag spyod kyis ni ting 'dzin 'dir sgom bzhin/ /gal te chos la bdag med so sor rtog /so sor de rtag sgom par byed pa ni/ /de ni mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu rgyu/ /rgyu gzhan gang yin de ni zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gang dag dran pa dang yid byed bkag nas/ mun pa la mig gcer ltas byas te had sgom byed pa dang / mtshan ma ci yang mi byed par/ rnam rtog thol skyes rbad chod byed pa ni/ rgya nag ha shang gi ring lugs ma nor ba 'dzin pa yin gsung /

ding sang gi sgom chen pa 'ga' zhig shin tu las sla bar do zin pa yod zer ba mang ste nyin par gyi snang ba 'di la a mthas nas/ rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa mi zin/ rmi lam zin par bar do'i 'khrul snang mi zin/ ro kha gdangs la grog nam babs su yong du re yang mi yongs gsung / de la sogs te lung dang rigs pa du ma'i sgo nas sun phyung bas/ sngar zhugs pa ldog pa dang / 'jug pa the tshom za ba dang / phyis mi 'jug pa la sogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad do/ /mtha' gnyis spang ba'i chu gter la gnas te/ /gdengs can dbang po klu sgrub ring lugs 'dzin/ /kho bo'i lta zer 'bar ba'i gzi brjid la/ /phas rgol 'dab stong gis ni rgol mi nus/ /'jigs tshogs lta ri spo mtho 'joms byed pa'i/ /lung rigs rdo rje'i gnam lcags stong yod kyang / /rmongs pa'i go cha sra brtan cher dgos pa'i/ /skye bo 'di la bdag gis ci byar yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /bstod par/ khyod ni rtsod pa mdzad tshe'ang dag pa dang / /rgya che gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /gzhan gyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba ste/ /khyod la g.yo ba nam yang mnga' ma lags/ /zhes dang / smra ba ngan rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /sun 'byin bgyid pa'i gnas rnams la/ /skyon yang yon tan lta bu dang / /yon tan skyon ltar snang ba yi/ /yang dag pa dang ltar snang gi /rnam par dbye ba'ang legs par bstan/ /de ltar log par 'gro ba bkag /ces dang / stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro cher sgrogs shing / /lung dang rig pa'i mche sder rab bsgrad de/ /log par smra ba'i wa tshogs pham byas nas/ /thub mchog bstan pa gangs ri legs par 'dzin/ /de phyir da lta 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di na/ /che bar rlom pa mang du snang mod kyang / /blo chen 'di ni 'dzam gling rgyan gcig pur/ /gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyi nges par gyis/ /zhes so/ /lung rtogs yon tan thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/

/ji bzhin mkhyen nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ de ltar gong du bstan pa'i lung rigs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs shing / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po mnga' bas/ gdul bya'i khams theg pa che chung gi rigs so sor mkhyen cing / bsam pa dbang po rno brtul dang / bag la nyal nyon mongs shas che chung ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen cing / chos kyi 'khor lo rang rang gi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa che chung chos rgyas 'bring bsdus pa sde snod gsum la sogs gang la gang 'os kyi zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bstan pa/ smin grol thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam phyin ci ma log par bstan nas/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa rjes su gzung ba'i gtso bor gyur pa ni 'di dag ste/ sbyangs pa'i mchog gyur kun mkhyen shes 'od dang / /sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /mang thos mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /'dul 'dzin mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /'phrin las mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /lta ba'i mchog gyur dgon gyo nyi ma grags/ /nyams len mchog gyur kun dga' dpal bzang po/ /brtse ldan mchog gyur dpal 'byor shes rab dang / /'chad mkhas mchog gyur bsod nams shes rab dang / /brtsod bzang mchog gyur dar ma rin chen te/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bcu pa chen po nam mkha' byang chad ni/ de dag dang ngo mnyam du byed do/ /gzhan yang bka' bcu ba mang ra ba yon tan rgyal mtshan/ bo dong bka' bcu pa grags pa'i tshul khrims/ byang pa bka' bcu pa dge legs dpal/ gnas snying bka' bcu pa mchog grub la sogs pa rnams/ mdo stod pa bka' bzhi 'dzin pa spre bo thang bzang / gnyal gro gor ba jo gdan mtshungs med/ las stod pa mkhan chen bud+dha shrī/ sta steng ba chen po byang bsod/

chen po byang rgyal/ bzang ldan pa don grub rin chen/ ngam rings pa dkon mchog dar/ mnga' ris pa yi dam dpal la sogs pa bka' bzhi 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig gsung / yang de las mang ba snang / lung rigs smra ba'i seng ge sgra tshad pa chos bzang / jo gdan grag she/ sngo phyi dbon po la sogs pa phar tshad mkhyen pa yang shin tu mang / rig pa smra ba rnams kyi nang na mchog rgyu gyur pa/ ri phug mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs/ dga' ldan gyi mkhan chen shākya shrī la sogs pa rigs pa smra ba'ang shin tu mang / stod lung pa bsod byang la sogs pa lung chos smra ba yang mang du byon/ 'di dag ni bdag nyid chen po'i gsung rab kho na las rtog pa 'khrung pa yin no/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po'i gsung rab la gzigs shing / sdom phrug rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ bo dong mkhan chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa dang / grags ram mkhan chen chos rgyal/ ngam rings pa mkhan chen rin chen dpal bzang / bzang ldan sde bdag slob dpon chen po nam mkha' dpal/ la stod nam mkha'i rnal 'byor mkhyen ldan dharmā mgon seng / stag tshang mkhan po seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gsang bu gling stod mkhan chen 'od chen pa/ gling smad mkhan chen bsod nams 'phel/ bka' bzhi 'dzin pa chen po nag rig slob dpon chen po snyal pa dang / rgyal dbang la sogs pa gsang phu'i slob dpon chen po phal che ba dang / dga' ba gdong pa'i mkhan chen/ bya yul rin po che/ lo mkhan po/ byang rwa bring gi mkhan po gnyis/ glang stag sher gsum gyi dbon chen/ rta sna chos lung gi mkhan po/ lha bdun gyi bla ma la sogs mnga' ris kyi sde snod 'dzin pa rnams ni/ nyi zla ltar grags pa'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob rigs yin/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gang zag ku su lu'i slob rigs rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ sgra tshad la sogs thos pa'i yon tan dang ldan yang / ku su lu'i spyod pa skyong zhing /

gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud shin tu snum par byas pas/ chos kyi rje dzñā na ba dang / lung rigs yon tan khur gyis lji yang / ku su lu'i spyod pa kho na lhur len pa mchog bzang legs pa'i blo gros dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal rgyun du gzigs shing / ku su lu'i spyod pa nyin mtshan 'da' ba bla ma rmi lam pa brtson 'grus seng ge dang / dbus pa bdag po'i bla ma chos rje rin bzang pa dang / tshe 'di blos btang zhing sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa/ ne ring pa sgrub pa dpal la sogs pa gnyug ma'i 'khor bya bral ba rnams so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur pa/ sa skya grang mo che'i mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan pa dang / chos rje lam 'bras pa blo bzang pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos dpal bzang po dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla ma bsod grags pa/ bla ma rgyal bzang pa/ sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba la sogs pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma shin tu mang / gzhan yang rab tu byung ba'i gdul bya mtha' yas so/ /rigs dang rus dang cho 'phrang dang bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i slob rigs ni/ 'dzam bu gling sum gnyis kyi bdag po/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa chos rgyal rnam pa gsum gyi dbon sras dam pa/ khri rgyal bsod nams lde yab yum sras dang bcas pa/ dam pa 'ba' zhig byung ba'i rigs sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud/ bla ma dbang gi sras po/ slob dpon chen po stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal pos se chen gan gyi gdung rgyud gong ma dge sbyong pa 'byor ldan ne'u dpon nam/ dad ldan yon tan rgya mtsho/ rig ldan 'u yug lha btsun/ gnas snying stong dpon rgyal bzang / stobs ldan rgya chos stag gsum pa/ khung btsun mnga' rig zhang blon 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa gdul bya mtha' yas pa la rgyu mngon par mtho ba dang / 'bras bu nges par legs pa la sogs pa thob pa'i thabs phyin ci ma log pa bstan no/

/kun mkhyen sher 'od blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /gzhung lugs legs par shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bzhi legs par smra ba bcu phrag gcig /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma brgya phrag rgal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar dngos kyi gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung nas ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa'i legs par bshad pa'i 'phreng ba de rnams mdzad de/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan mchog bka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla dang / /chos mngon mdzod dang dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /rnam bshad byas pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag gcig /ces gsungs kyang / der ma 'dus pa lung kun las btus pa'i ṭīk+ka/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog bdag 'jug mchod phreng / mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa go bde 'jug par sla ba'i man ngag rin po che bka' bum thor bu ba la sogs pa/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyi ston pa yi ge'i ngos na gzhug pa dpe lnga bcu rtsa lnga mdzad do/ /mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nga ni yi ge'i ngos la gnas/ /zhes gsungs/ bstod par/ mkhas pa dgyes pa'i lam du 'khrid/ /mang thos chud mi za yi rgyu/ /de don bsgrub la'ang rab tu sbyor/ /de phyir khyod kyi gdul bya la/ /bgyi bar 'os pa ma lus mdzad/ /phan mdzad khyod la dus kun tu/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /lta ba rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab zab mos/ ma brtags nyam dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur kun rdzob rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur ma 'dres par so sor gzigs shing /

don dam bden pa chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil ltar brjod du med pa'i don/ so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa yin te/ kho bo la dbu ma'i rtogs pa skyes tshul rim pa bzhi byung ste/ 'di ltar dang po chad stong / gnyis pa snang stong / gsum pa rten 'brel sgyu mar go ba/ bzhi pa rten 'brel brtags yod gzhi med du go ba'o/ /de la dang po ni bum pa tho bas bcom pa ltar/ kun rdzob rdzas yod rigs pas bshig pa'i stong pa nyid de/ 'dis kyang rigs dpyad kyi bden 'dzin bzlog cing / stong nyid la mos pa'i rgyu tsam byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ste/ 'dis phyis gzung ba la sgro bkur gyi rtog pa mtha' dag bzlog kyang / nang myong rig la brod pa'i zhen pa mi 'dor bas/ sems tsam rnam brdzun pa'i lta ba las ma 'das/ gsum pa ni/ nang myong rig dang phyi gzung ba gnyis ka yang rgyu rkyen la rag lus pas/ sgyu ma ltar kun rdzob tu yang snang ba tsam las rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par rtogs pa ste/ 'di la yang mthar 'dzin gyi zhen pa ci yang med kyang / rten 'brel sgra rtog la ma ltos pa'i don chos sgyu ma tsam du 'dzin pa yod pas/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa las ma 'das/ bzhi pa ni/ rten 'brel gyi chos rnams rigs pas tshul bzhin du bcad pa na/ rang gi ngo bo cung zad kyang mi rnyed cing / ma dpyad pa na tha snyad kyi yul du gyur pa/ rtog pas brtags shing / ming gi tha rnyed du byas pa tsam gyis brtags yod du rtogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rang bzhin gyi rten 'brel rtogs pa'i blo de nyid kyis/ blo gzhan la ltos med du rgyu 'bras phan tshun mi 'khrul ba dang / rten 'brel rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba gcig 'ong ba yin gsung / lta ba 'di gzhan gyi thugs yul du ma chud par chad lta yin zer ba mang na yang /

khas len thams cad dang bral ba'i lta ba 'di klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ gal te ngas dam bcas 'ga' yod/ /des na nga la skyon 'di yod/ /nga la dam bca' med pas na/ /nga ni skyon med kho na 'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang / 'ga' zhig rang rgyud kyi dam bca' med/ rang lugs kyi dam bcas yod ces zer yang / ming spos pa tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par 'ga' yang med gsung / mkhas pa gzhan dag gi lta ba bzang bzang por 'dod pa rnams kyang / bdag 'dzin la gros dris nas bzhag par kho nar zad/ nga'i lta ba 'di yang nga rang dang sdongs nas 'gro ba gcig yong par 'dug ste/ shin tu mad/ chos rje blo bzang pas 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba dgongs tshul zhus pas/ da dung ma go gsungs/ 'o na khyed dpon slob la khyed pas/ slob dpon pas kyang ma dgongs zhus pas/ khong gis go yod/ zhib cha 'ga' yar ni ma go gsung / de ltar grags kyang / chos rje pa'i gdul bya pho rus che zhing / mkhyen rab chung ba 'ga' zhig yab sras gnyis chos rje pa'i lta ba mchog yin te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs pa'i phyir zer ba ni mi rigs te/ 'jam dbyangs dang mi dang mi bzhin 'grogs shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang chos rje pas ches cher lhag pa'i bya ba mdzad pa paṇa chen zhi ba 'tshos kyang / thal 'gyur gyi lta ba thugs su ma chud pa rgya bod kun tu grags shing / don la yang gnas te/ rang rgyud pa'i shing rta chen po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa dang dngos su 'jal bas lta ba bzang la/ ma 'jal bas lta ba ngan pa'i nges pa med de/ slob dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa bzhin no/ /drung pa la chad lta ba yin zer mkhan brda' lags zhus pas/ yod nyen yod/ sngon ston pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su dge sbyong go'u ta ma ni chad par smra ba'o/

/zhes zer mkhan byung 'dug de'i rjes su klu sgrub yab sras dpal ldan zla ba/ khu byug che chung la'ang de bzhin zer mkhan byung 'dug bod du yang dbu ma pa chen po gangs pa shi'u/ khu mdo sde/ 'bar spa tshab nyi ma grags/ lce sgom zhig po sogs la'ang chad lta bar grags 'dug 'u bu yang chad lta yin yang grogs bzang bar yod kyi gsung / karma pa dkon gzhon gyis kyang / khyed chad lta ba yin byas pas/ nga chad lta ba e yin/ nga'i spyod pa 'di la ltos gsungs pas/ khyed shin tu mad par gda'o/ /bzod par gsol ces zhus par grags/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /mngon sum byon nas dbyangs dang mgrin gcig gis/ /'di las gzhan du thar pa'i lam ston yang / /bdag blo g.yo ba med do grogs po dag /ces gsungs/ de ltar phyir mi ldog pa'i rtogs pa brtan po thob pa yin no/ /bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /sdom pa gsum ldan nyes ltung dri ma bral/ /sgo gsum ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang du bzhag /spyod pa rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di ni/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas/ thugs rgyud shin tu dul ba la/ lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas rab tu zhi zhing / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /so sor thar pa bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yan lag brgyad/ dge bsnyen gyi yan lag lnga/ dge tshul gyi yan lag bcu/ dge slong gi khrim nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la nyes ltung gi dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa yin te/ gang zhig legs gsung dam chos 'dul ba la/ /rab tu byung nas legs par mi sdom zhing / /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min zlo byed pa'i/ /dge sbyong de dag 'jig rten chom rkun yin/ /'khyog por smra la gzhan dag rling por sems/ /ngag mi btsun pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/

/gya gyu'i sems dang de yi tshul spangs te/ /gsong por smra la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /'dzad med smra ba gzhan dag spobs par sems/ /ngag mi sdom pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ mu cor smra ba smyon pa'i tshul spangs te/ /zhi ba'i tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /phyi tshul 'chos la gzhan dag btsun por sems/ /g.yo rgyu'i spyod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /pha rol brid byed yon po'i tshul spangs te/ /des pa'i tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /rang dga'i spyod pa gzhan dag drang por sems/ /dbang po mi sdom dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /bag dang mi ldan hral po'i tshul spangs te/ /bag yod tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /bya byed mang ba gzhan dag grung por sems/ /rnam g.yeng 'dod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /'du 'dzis brel ba khyim pa'i tshul spangs te/ /don nyung tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /longs spyod 'byor pa gzhan dag dpal du sems/ /'dod zhen che ba dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /zang zing dang bcas grong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /chog shes tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /grong 'dab 'grim pa gzhan dag gdul byar sems/ /rnyed bkur sgrub pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /khe spogs 'dod pa tshong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin no/ /gzhan phan mtha' dag sgrub pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyang rnam par dag pa yin te/ rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /zhes pa'i nyes pas ma gos te/ gang du gnas na snang shas 'phel 'gyur zhing / /rang rgyud brnyed bkur zhag pas 'ching byed pa/ /gzhan rgyud phrag dog 'gran sems kyis gdungs pa'i/ /gnas der skad cig tsam yang mi gnas so/ /gzhan gyis nyes pa nam yang mi gleng zhing / /don dang ldan zhing chos mthun la gtogs pa/

/dmag dang chom rkun rgyal po'i gtam la sogs/ /'khrul pa'i bka' mchid nam yang mi bgyid do/ /zhes gsungs/ sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas mchod gtor mi gter dang / /zhes pa'i nyes pas ma gos te/ chos don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya mgon med rnams la dpe mkhyud spangs te/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa rang nam tshim gyi bar du ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gdul bya rdzas don du gnyer ba mgon med pa rnams la yang rdzas la ser sna spangs te/ dbul 'phongs kyi re ba bskong bar mdzad do/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di mang yul gyi grong na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ zhabs tog pa med pa la/ 'dze pho pha phad gnyis yong nas/ bsod snyoms grags pa gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ nang du gshegs nas/ tsam skyal kog ge gcig gnang pas/ sha gcig kyang thugs la thog zer ba la/ sha lag pa gcig gnang / sku byug gi chas mar gcig kyang gnang bar zhu zer nas btsal bas mar gong phyed bshag gcig rnyed pa'ang gnang / ras lcags 'ga' yar yang gnang zhes grags/ dga' ba gdong du khams pa gcig gis ja la gdan drangs bsngo rten/ ghang dkar po gcig phul/ tshul byon pa'i lam du sprang po gcig gis gnang sbyin zhus pas phyag phyir btsun chung gcig yod pa la gos yug de byin gsungs nas gnang / yang lha sar gshegs pa'i lam du sprang po gnyis la dngul gyi rdo rje re re gnang / lha sar sprang po mang po 'dus nas/ gnang sbyin zhus pas/ nye 'khor na yod pa'i grogs thams cad bos shig gsungs pas/ khong pas lha sa sde bzhi'i sprang po thams cad bsdus nas/ sprang rdzus dang bcas pas lnga brgya tsam byung pa la/ dar kha dang gos kha 'dres pa spung nas sprang po 'phrang la bshar nas/ sna zin re gnang pas sprang po rgan po gcig na re/ lha sar bla ma nga bzang zer ba mang po byung ste/ 'bar ba pa dang 'di gnyis las drag pa ma byung / 'bar ba pas rin rgyab dar kha re'i thag skye/

'dis rang re'i gsod de kha la dar kha gos kha gang zin re byung pa yin zer ro/ /bul rong du bzhugs dus/ ko kar gyis sha phyed gang zag la bzhag mar gong gcig bya rog 'ga' yis gang mthor la bzhag pa sogs/ rdzas la ser sna mi 'da' ba yin te/ bdag po ba la bdag gir 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ gser dngul gos dar sogs ci phul yang spyan gzigs pa tsam ma gtogs gces spras su 'dzin pa'i phyag len dang zhal lta sogs gang yang mi mdzad do/ /gzhan gyi bshags kyang mi nyan par/ khros nas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang / ces pa'i nyes pa yang mi mnga' ste/ bdag nyid chen po gtsang du gshegs shul du/ chos rje rnam gnyis rwa sgreng du byon dus/ nyin gcig bya bral du chos rje lo tsā bas/ chos rje blo bzang grags pa la/ khyed yab sras gnyis kyi 'dir zla ba gnyis gsum du sku mtshams dam po mdzad nas/ chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du mdzad pa yod par gda' ba/ drung rje btsun pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ci mnga' gsung gi gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i yon tan mkhas btsun bzang gsum pa chos mthun gyi rnal 'byor ba dang bral ba der gda' zhus pas/ de'ang min pa'i thun mong min pa 'dra gsungs bsdog pa da lan cis kyang gsung par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i yon tan chung shos gda' lags na'ang / sa skya nas 'chad nyan bshol te/ bul rong du zhal gzigs nas/ tha ma da lta'i bar la khong khro tsha 'khrug pa gcig kyang skyes ma myong gsung gin gda' lags gsungs nas/ spyan chab cher g.yos pas/ chos rje lo tsā bas kyang spyan chab btang nas gsung gton te bshums zhes thos/ theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i nyes pa'i mnga' ste/ theg pa chen po dbu sems gnyis rdo rje theg pa dang bcas pa phyin ci ma log par dgongs pa'i phyir ro/ /nyon mongs lam du bsgyur ba rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa la'ang nyes ltung gi ma reg ste rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/

yan lag gi brgyad rnams kyis phal cher ma gos shing / re re tsam byung srid na'ang dus las ma 'das par bshags sdom mdzad pa'i phyir/ theg chen bslab pa'i bsam sbyor nyams pa med/ /ces so/ sku'i spyod pa ma bcos pa yin te/ tshul 'chos dang bral/ gsung gi spyod pa ma bcos pas bzhogs blongs kha zag thob 'jab sogs dang bral/ thugs kyi spyod pa ma bcos pa rnams sems g.yo rgyu sogs dang bral/ gang byung gis chog na ci byas kyang bde ba khyab brdal lhug pa'i spyod pa mdzad do/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /bden gnyis rten 'brel phyin drug rim gnyis bsgom/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyed/ /nyams len rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ kho bo dben pa brten pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / /'khor dang grogs kyis yid sun phyung ba 'am/ /rnyed bkur grags pa 'dod phyir ma yin gyi/ /gzhan du na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me 'obs ltar shin tu brnag dka' bar mthong ba'i phyir/ de yang 'di ltar/ srid pa'i phun tshogs shin tu gnog chung zhing / /rab mang nyes pa'i tshogs dang ldan rigs nas/ /rang gzhan srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /mang thos bdag ni dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /char 'dod byi 'us 'brug sgra thos pa ltar/ /dben pa'i gtam 'di kho bo'i snying la 'bab/ /thos pa'i don rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /ngang pa'i tshogs kyis pad+mo'i mtsho mthong ltar/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bo sems rab g.yo/ /dal 'byor lus la snying po blang bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /bung ba gzhon nu 'dab brgya'i tshal mthong ltar/ /kho bo'i yid ni dben pa'i ro la chags/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i ro de myang bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /dpyid dus bsil ba'i ma la ya rlung ltar/

/nags kyi sman ljongs kho bo'i yid la 'bab/ /nyon mongs bdud kyi sde de gzhom bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /gsungs nas/ sa skya'i brgya dpon dang / bzang ldan gyi mkhan po sogs mdzad pa'i zhu ba phul nas/ mi lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bstan pa la bsam/ 'chad nyan byas nas/ rgas kha 'dir sde gog gcig la mi 'jug gsungs te/ sku tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad spangs nas/ gangs bu me dkar po'i gangs mgul g.yu lung rdo rje rdzong gi dben gnas su sgrub pa la byon nas/ lo lnga'i bar du rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa nyan thos kyi sgom/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs skad cig bcu drug bsgoms/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa rang rgyal gyi sgom/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu bsgoms/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med bstan la 'bebs pa byang sems kyi sgom/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'khor gsum rnam dag tu bsgoms/ nyon mongs lam du 'gyur bar rig 'dzin gyi sgom/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyed pa yin te/ rnal 'byor rdo rje'i sku la rtag bzhugs pa/ /ting 'dzin yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag ste/ /de ni rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su brjod/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang mchog bzhi par grags/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'ang de yin te/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dam pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ de dus su/ gangs can gyi bshad sgrub pa kun gyis ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs thams cad gcod par byed pa'i gnas dam par gyur cing / kun mkhyen bzhin du dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs par mdzad do/ /thugs dam zab mo gnad du snun pa'i rtags/ /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/

/rgyun du gzigs kyang rang rgyal brtul shugs brten/ /ngo mtshar smad byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni gong du bstan pa'i thugs dam zab mo de dag gis nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'da' ba'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs kyang rang rgyal bzhin tu mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs brten par mdzad do/ /'ga' yar gyis/ drung pas thugs dam mdzad pa la rtags khyad par can ci byung lags zhus pas/ mi tshe chos la skyal ba la rtags than thun yod srid de/ mi bshad 'jig rten gyi bya ba chung ngu la'ang bsangs nas bsgrubs na 'grub kyin 'dug pa/ rtags rnams bshad na nyams par 'gyur zhing / mkha' 'gro'ang mi mnyes pa 'dug gsungs nas/ ched du gnyer nas zhus pa phal cher mi gsungs/ yengs ma lam la thal lo gsungs pa dang / dben sar yang yang nan gyi zhus pa gsungs pa re re tsam bdag gis thos pa 'di ltar lags/ bu ler bla ma rgyal bzang pas/ mkhan chen g.yag pa'i gsungs nas/ slob dpon gzhon nu blo ba'i dbu ma la'ang rgyud pa'i bla ma med/ nga yang slob dpon med rung ston gsungs pa dang / la la na re zla grags kyi sku'i skye ba yin/ la la na re zla grags la dngos su chos gsan zer ba gang lags zhus pas/ dbu ma'i tshig gi rgyud pa ni yod/ don gyi rgyud pa yong pa dka' mor 'dug dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i skye ba min par thag chod/ chos nyan ma nyan dpon slob nang byan tshud cing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par grags/ min na log lta skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur gsungs/ bdag gi drung pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ci ston yang yon tan du mthong ba ma gtogs/ skyon du mi rtog par mchis pas/ cis kyang gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ yug gcig ci yang mi gsung bar 'dug yengs ma ngang la dpal ldan zla ba rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang brnyes nas/ ding sang yang rgya gar na bzhugs yod pa yin/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la/

khong gi drung rang du snyag dgos pa yang ma yin gsungs pa dang / bla ma lha pas phyag rdor grub thob tu mi rkang btsugs btang nas/ slob dpon gzhon blo dang / byang pa 'jam dbyangs kyis gcig gis lta log gi bdag rkyen byas/ gcig gis lta log dar rgyas su byas pa 'di/ phyi ma gar skye gsang bdag la zhu grogs zhu byas pas/ phyag rdor grub thob kyis gsang bdag la zhus pa'i lan la slob dpon gzhon blo ba theg pa chen po'i gang zag khyad par can yin/ khong gi lta ba de yang / zla grags kyis rmi lam du bstan pa yin gsung / 'jam dbyangs pa 'di sa paṇa gyi dngos slob mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa gcig yin/ da lta longs spyod dang ldan pa yang sa paṇa la tshogs 'khor gcig zhus pa'i rnam smin yin zer ba'i lan khyer 'ongs pas/ lha pa na re/ de ga yin phyag rdor gyi grub thob gcig yod na nga'i sna bar thos dogs med gsungs zer/ de'i lo rgyus bdag nyid chen po la slong rtser zhus pas/ khong gi yid la nga dmyal bar skye ba 'dug zer ba gcig yong du re ba yin te/ de rang mi yong mchis gsungs/ yang bul rong du bzhugs pa'i dus/ zhabs bskor mdzad 'phro la kho de ba brag ya gi na sgrol ma gcig zhugs kyin 'dug gsung / gang na gda' lags zhus pas/ phyag mdzub gtsug nas ya gi gsungs/ mi gda' lags zhus pas de ka yin gsung ngo / /smu rdzing du gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gsung dus sgrub chen ma dpal mo'i dbon mo sgrub chung ma yang nyan gin yod pa chos thun gyi mgo zug nas grol grol gyi bar rgyun du rgod pa 'ga' yar byung / rjes su khyod rgod pa ci yin dris pas/ mkha' 'gro'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha dog rgyan dang gos dang spyod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma chos nyan du byung ba la rgod pa yin zer/ chos rje blo bzang pa dpon slob 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs dus dgong mo thun gtor gcig la/

tshogs par rtog ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mang du 'dus nas bstod pa 'di 'don kyin 'dug pa gzigs/ gangs bu le dkar po'i g.yas mgul na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug red mda' ba/ /mtha' bral gyi dbu ma thugs su chud/ /rgyud sde mthar thug dpal gsang 'dus/ /thun mong ma yin klu sgrub lugs/ /bul rong du bzhugs dus/ mi nag po chung nge ba/ gdong pa bzhi yod pa gcig gtor ma len du byung pa la/ khyed gang nas 'ong byas pas/ te se nas 'ong zer/ zhal bzhi pa yin par grags so/ /nye gnas mchog legs la mdang chos skyong chung pa de yong 'dug pas/ gtor ma 'bags 'dug da man chad ma 'bag pa gyis gsungs pas/ mdang spu tra de 'ong kha lhag lhag nas so bsod du ma bcug gsung / smu rdzings du rgyud mchod byas dus sgrub chung mas gzigs pas/ bdag nyid chen po'i mgul nas 'jig rten dbang phyug mas 'khyud nas thod pa sha lnga'i bdud rtsi lngas gang ba drung pa la yang zhus/ khong rang yang gsol gyin 'dug zer/ bul rong du tshogs 'khor gcig gi dus su bla ma sgrub pa dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ bdag dang gsum yod pa las/ drung gi gsung nas/ nga'i yid la da rang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnal ma med bsam na'ang bu rgyud mgo 'chad nas ma grol gyi bar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ma'i rta'i rmig pa zad zad bskor ba byed pa sgrub chung ma des mthong zer gyin 'dug da dung yang bstan pa la a tho yang yod par 'dug gsungs/ bul rong du rta khrid kyi gsol 'debs mdzad dus mtshan mo bud med dkar mo gsum yong nas/ gsol 'debs de la kog 'di 'dra gcig mdzad par zhu zer nas/ khong rnams kyis kog 'di byas nas blangs so/ /yang bul rong du sgrub chung ma la rim lnga'i dmigs pa zhag bcu gsum tsam nas re re 'bog kyin yod pa la/ dmigs pa gcig zhag gnyis tsam la/ mi gzhon gos dkar po gyon pa gcig 'ongs nas chu chu me thong /

tshod ma kol ba sogs g.yog gang dgos byed cing / gtam mi zer ba gcig byung / sgrub chung mas kyang ye ma lab/ dmigs pa zhu ru phyin dus zhag gnyis tsam gyi gong du mi gzhon de 'byung ba'i lo rgyus zhus nas/ ci lags sam zhus pas/ ci yin mi shes khyed rang dge sbyor la 'bungs/ ngas kyang dmigs pa gzung gis gsungs/ log nas phyin pas mi de da dung sngar bzhin g.yog gang dgos byed kyin 'dug zhag bcu tsam song pa dang / nga 'gro 'dod pa yin te/ khyed kyi bla mas lung pa mes bkang nas 'gro sa mi 'dug bla ma la thugs dam slod zer ba zhu grogs gyis zer ba lan ci yang ma byas/ yang dmigs pa zhu ru phyin dus khyed kyi mi da dung 'dug gam gsungs/ khong zer tshul zhus pas/ ngas thugs dam tsam cher byas pa med/ da khong rang 'gro yong gsung / drung nas srung 'khor bshig pas/ log phyin dus song nas mi 'dug dpe dkar bar chod la yong par 'dug gsungs/ brag dkar sta sor bzhugs dus kyang dpe dkar gyi gzugs dgon pa'i khong kheb pa gcig byung nas/ drung pa la mig ngan lta yin 'dug thugs dam la bzhugs pas rang yal la song / yang bul rong du slob dpon nam mkha' dpal bas zhu zhig phul nas mnga' rigs pa'i mnga' bdag de grongs sam zhes sgrogs kyin brda' lags pas/ thugs dam la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ de nub dmigs nas gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod gcig mdzad/ nam langs pa dang / mnga' bdag pa gnas po che'i skyel ma la byon pa'i cha lugs ji lta ba bzhin sku mdun du byung pas drung nas yengs ma ngang la/ khyed grongs 'dug zer ba e bden gsungs pas/ dbu gug pa gsum mdzad nas bzhugs khri la thim song gsungs/ yang chos rje dzñā na ba grongs dus kyang / bla ma dzñā na ba de mdang sang 'dir byon byung ste/ sku gshegs pa 'dra gsung / dus tshod bsgrig pas de'i nub dang 'grig par byung / smyung gzhi drag po gcig byung dus thugs dam la bzhugs kyang smyung zug ches pas sku spar spar 'phar ba dang /

rgyu chu ltar 'grug pa byung dus/ gang gis rten cing 'brel par 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ongs pa med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi ston pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lan gsum ston pas smyung sangs pa byung / bla ma sgrub pa dpal bas zhabs tog mdzad dus/ rtug pa thug bsheg pas 'phyis te/ gdan yol bar 'dug dgongs/ khong pa rang gi bshos g.yos shing / yod pa la bla mas phebs kyang nang du 'gro ma nus par sgo gseng nas gzigs pas/ bshos dkrug ste sku mdun du phog ste/ chos thams cad ming tsam brda' tsam tha snyad tsam btags pa tsam mo gsungs nas/ gshos phru'i nang nas ka gsol kyin 'dug pas khong shin tu dad par gyur to/ /sa skyar mang ja gcig la dung ma byung par byon te/ gtso thab kyi 'gram du bzhugs nas khrom chu la spyan ha re gzigs te/ spyan chab na ra ra 'dug ja gsol rgyag kyang ma chad/ nang du log byon kyang ma chad/ phebs pa dang / spro bo thar bzang gis khyed kyi slob dpon de za bzhin kyang ngu / 'gro yin kyang ngu ba ci yin zer bas/ bdag gi snang ba la nya sram gyis za ba gzigs nas spyan chab byung ba yin nam snyam de ci lags zhus pas/ de yang ma yin/ khrom chu khro khro lo 'gro yin 'dug pa de la/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis gcig brtags nas bsgoms pas/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba rnal ma gcig skyes byung / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du 'dug pas mchi ma byung ba yin gsung / shangs su chos bar la byon dus drung pa la chibs gcig yod pa bshol nas byon/ grwa ba rnams sngon la byon nas rab la rgal/ drung nas rta gang 'gro ba btang nas/ 'khor mo zab mo gcig la chud 'dug pa la/ grwa ba rnams kyis rgyug ku co byas kyang rta thad ka la btang pas chu la thugs kha tsam man chad nub pa byung rung rta btang kyang ma shor ba 'dug

de 'dra'i mdzad lugs zhus pas/ rta kho rkang lag gtsug pa gcig mi 'gyel bar 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang chos bar la gshegs dus sa cha yangs pa rnams su thugs dam la yengs nas/ zhal gang tshur tshugs su gshegs te/ spyan 'dren du 'gro dgos mang du byung zer/ mnga' ris nas/ chos rje grags pa'i phyag phyi mdzad de rtsang po la gshegs dus kyang / thugs dam la 'byams nas/ chibs pas yang yang bskyur/ zhabs thog bya dgos mang du byung pas/ rta rdzi na re/ slob dpon gzhon blo'i mi dgos pa'i sgom 'dis/ sdug rir bsod pa 'dug zer/ shel dkar gyi 'du khang du gzims pa mdzad/ spyi khang gi steng na gdan gsol ba mdzad kyin yod pa la/ nyin gcig bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi dus mchod gcig zhus dus/ mi drug bdun gcig spyi khang na yod pas/ ma mthong par drung pa steng na phebs 'dug khang pa dog mo 'dir 'u regs pas ma mthong par drung pas phebs pa rdzu 'phrul yin nam zhes ngo mtshar du gyur/ drung nas dbus la byon pa'i dus su/ chos rje dpon slob sum brgya tsam gyis ser 'phreng gis bsus/ chos rje bas phyag phul ba la phyag lan mdzad bzhed pa la/ mi mdzad par zhu zhus nas/ de mar chad phyag lan ma mdzad pas/ dbus pa'i dge bshes chen po rnams kyang / phyag lan mdzad pa'i spro ba dang bral bar gyur kyang / drung gnas gsang sde'i mkhan po/ stan lung lo tsā ba sogs la phyag phar mdzad pas/ jo bo bzang pa'i grags pa yang cher thog go /de nas dga' ba gdong du chos rje blo bzang grags pas gtso mdzad/ bka' bcu pa nam mkha' byang chad/ bsod she dar ma/ bka' brgyad pa 'ga' yar dang / phar tshad mkhyen pa lnga brgya tsam la dbu ma 'jug pa dang / lta khrid gsungs pas/ me tog gi char babs thams cad shin tu gus par gyur to/ /de dus gsang phu ba ldan ma kun seng langs te/ chos rje yab sras gnyis la zhu ba re yod pas/ gsan du gsol/ gtsang na mkhas pa red mda' ba/

dbus na mkhas pa blo bzang zer nas/ khyed yab sras gnyis dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i bdag por grags gda' bas/ da zhal 'dzoms dus 'dir/ theg pa gsum grub mtha' bzhi'i bshad srol mdzad pa rnams lkog tu mi mdzad par/ bdag cag dbus gtsang gi don gnyer ba rnams kyi log rtog dang the tshom bsal ba'i phyir/ tshogs su 'bel gtam mdzad par zhu ba dang / lung rigs kyis dgag bsgrub mdzad nas kho thag chod pa'i chos 'khor yun ring du bskor du gsol/ de nas rje btsun chen po yang gangs bu le dang / chos rje rje blo bzang grags pa yang 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la gshegs mi gsung bar dbus gtsang gi gzhung du bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad du gsol zhes zhus so/ /de dus drung nas dge 'dun rnams la mang ja dar 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /de nas sne'ur byon dus/ yab sras gnyis kyi gtso mdzad/ dge bshes bzang la rags pa bdun cu tsam gyis tsha bral du gsang phu ba'i dge bshes gcig langs nas/ khyed yab sras gnyis la zhu ba tshig re yod pas/ mi 'chab par gsong por gsung ba zhu/ bla ma rje btsun pa'i gsung nas/ spyir bka' bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa gzhung lugs mgo 'jug gi 'gang go ba re dgos pa yin/ tshig gi phreng ba re bltas te shes shes rang la snying po tsam med gsungs pa e bden zhus pas/ ngas de 'dra rang byas su ma tshor/ lar de 'dra gcig 'dug pa gsungs pas bla ma'i drung nas don gyis zhal gyis bzhes par gda' bas/ mi 'chab par gsungs pa thugs la btags zer/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung nas/ gzhung lugs kyi 'gangs gshog na nga'i bla ma dgos pa yin/ dka' gnas kyi tshig spu ris 'byed na/ a bo rgan chen dgos pa yin gsungs pa e bden zhus pas/ chos rje pa zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ cang mi gsung pa la khong na re/ yab sras gnyis kyang jo bo bzang ngan mchod rten gyi bang rim bzhin log ge 'dug zer ro/ /yang sne'u'i tsha gral gcig tu slob dpon snyal pa zer ba gsang phu gling bstod kyi gdan sa byed rgyu grwa pa brgya tsam yod pa gcig gis/
