zhabs dbang gnang pa zhu zhus pas/ khyed 'dra ba'i dge bshes chen po la de 'dra gar yong gsungs nas ma gnang pas/ nga yang tshe 'jug 'dir dpal ldan red mda' ba'i zhabs kyi pad mo dri ma med pa la gtug zer ba gcig 'dod pa yin/ btsun rgan 'jigs mi dgos rkang pa bzhog zhus pas/ 'o na g.ya' gsung nas zhabs dbang mdzad do/ /de nas lha sar byon nas/ dge 'dun brgyad brgya/ mi nag pa drug brgya tsam la skyid sdug lam khyer gcig gsungs/ de dus chos rje blo bzang grags pas jo bo'i drung du mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te/ bla ma jo bo'i drung du bzhugs te smon lam mdzad du gsol zhus nas/ khong pa rang gis gtso mdzad dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam gyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa gcig phul/ gtso bo bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / khong pa rang gis mdzad pa'i bde ba can gyi smon lam rgya cher btab/ khyad par du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ku ma ra ma tis gtso mdzad bstan pa'i rtsa lags skyes chen zhal bzhugs thams cad bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du zhabs brtan par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum mdzad do/ /de dus drung nas zhabs dbang su zhu la gnang / chos rje pas ye ma gnang pas/ gsang phu ba'i grwa pa rnams na re/ red mda' ba kho 'chi bas mi 'jigs pa'i zhabs dbang su zhu la gnang gin 'dug blo bzang 'chi bas 'jigs pas su la yang mi gnang pa 'dug zer ba yang byung / de nas rwa sgreng la 'byon dus brag dkar mo pa/ bya yul rin po che/ lo mkhan po/ 'bri khung pa'i stag rtse rdzongs pa rnams kyis 'bul snod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas stag rtse phu la byon pas/ dge 'dun sum brgya tsam gyi gdan chad nas kun bsod snyoms la byon pas/ gdan theb tsam byung / de nas lo pa'i tshogs pa chos 'brel zhur byung ste/ tsam pa mdzo rgyab nyi shu lhag pa tsam gcig phul pas/ slar mi theg pa'i sdug bsngal du gyur/ chos rje yab sras nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' mnyes pa 'dra zer ba'i grags pa byung /

de nas rwa sgreng du phyag phebs/ dngul gdugs can che chung / gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi gtso mdzad rten gsum ngo mtshar can rnams la phyag dang mchod pa rgya chen phul nas/ dgon pa gong du yab sras gnyis sku mtshams bcad pa'i bu sgo nas/ gzhi byes kyi tshogs pa drug brgya tsam la skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen pos/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong / bzhi brgya pa'i bshad pa/ sku mtshams grol nas/ rig pa drug bcu pa'i bshad pa rgyas pa gcig gnang nas/ grol dus kho bo klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'chad na de lta bu 'chad/ mi re re'i rtog pa dang bstun nas gzhung lugs 'chad pa kun mkhyen gyis kyang dka' gsungs/ chos rje pa 'bri khung du byon shul/ bka' bcu pa gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ gsang bde gung gsum rtse thang sogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa bdun cu tsam la gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi bshad pa rgyas pa gcig gnang pas/ ldan ma dkon seng dang / nam mkha' gshog ral la sogs pa cung mi dad pa rnams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas yab sras gnyis stag lung mdor zhal 'dzoms dus/ 'ol ka stag rtse ba'i jo mo chos 'brel zhur yong pa gcig la/ chos smyo byung pa la/ drung gi gsung nas dge 'dun gcig rgyugs la jo mo ma gi'i lag pa g.yas pa 'og tu bzhog la/ khyed kyi lag pa g.yas pas steng nas rgyob dang gsung pa la/ de bzhin byas pas jo mo smyo ba sangs/ 'khor phal mo che'i bsam pa la/ 'di sde snod la mkhas pa min par/ bgegs sel sogs mi mkhyen snyam pa yod pa la/ kun ngo mtshar che bar gyur to/ /de nas stag lung du spyan drangs te/ stag lung rin po ches na bza' phyibs pa/ ja sig sogs 'bul snod rgya chen po mdzad/ tshogs pas tshogs chos zhus/ stag lung pa kun gus par gyur to/

/de nas gnam rtse ldeng gi gtsug lag khang du chos rje lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po dang / chos rje yab sras gnyis kyis gtso mdzad dbyar gnas khas blang pa'i dge 'dun lnga brgya/ phyogs nas chos 'brel la 'dus pa dang bcas pa brgyad brgya tsam byung pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen pos gung chos 'dul ba/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug gnyis/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ lta khrid rnams gnang / gzhan yang phyogs nas byon pa rnams la chos 'brel ci 'dod gnang / de dus chos rje blo bzang grags pas dbyar gnas rgyags gang byung gi dngos po drag pa rnams 'bul ba'i dam bca' mdzad nas/ gser srang re'i maṇ+ḍal thengs gsum phul/ gzhan yang dngos po byung res kyis spyan drangs nas/ khong pa rang gis 'bul ba 'bul/ smon lam 'debs/ bsngo ba zhu ba sogs mdzad cing / de'i gong du yang gser gar lug dang / li sku'i 'jam dpal zhal gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ gser dngul gos dar sogs 'bul snod rgya chen po mdzad cing / rjes su yang dngul bre chen na bza' cha tshang thang 'ga' yar/ gsol ja rgyun ma chad par phul nas/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags bsten pa bzhin mdzad do/ /dbyar gnas grol ba dang / gtsang du byon nas sa skyar phyag phebs te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du/ ta hun gyi snam sbyar bzang po gcig bla re gcig tshogs pa stong bskor brgyad brgya tsam la mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas bul rong tu sku mtshams dam po la lo gsum bzhugs dus bu le rgyun du gtor ma len du yong gin yod pa/ nyin gcig sgrub chung mas kyang mthong nas/ rgod pas ci 'dug gsung / kho bu le gtor ma len du yong gi gda' zhus zer/ dang po smu rdzing du chos bar mdzad dus nam langs pa dang / gzhi bdag mo khyung lung ma sku mdun na yar rdol nas/ rgyan cha lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ phyag 'tshal/ byin brlabs zhus nas sa la thim song /

snga dro tsha dus su gzhi bdag mo'i gzugs gyang ngos la bris pa gcig gzigs nas/ mo 'di 'dra ba gcig mi 'dug 'di bas brgya 'gyur gyis mdzes pa gcig 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus bud med gcig la gzhi bdag mo babs nas/ sngon gyi dge slong de tsho phebs pas/ zhabs tog yang dag pa phul zer nas/ sngon gyi dge slong ni byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ de dus mkhan chen dpal 'byor/ slob dpon dar ma sogs lnga la mdzod kyi rang 'grel gyi steng nas mdzub khrid mdzad pas lnga kas mdzod dga' mo shes pa re byung / 'di 'dra ba'i 'chad nyan brod po yin zhes mnyes tshor chen po mdzad do/ /ngam rings rtse mor blo bzang sogs dpon slob bcu drug gis chos bar mdzad dus ngam rings shod na mkhan chen bstan rgyal ba dpon slob bdun brgya tsam 'chad nyan mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ drung pa'i thugs dgongs la khong dpon slob bdun brgya po dang nged dpon slob bcu drug po bstan pa la su phan che'am dgongs pa gcig byung / dus phyis khong bdun brgya pos blo bzang grags pa gcig po yang mi do bar 'dug gsung / dang po bu ston rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo mkhan chen dharmā shrī dpon slob lnga bcu tsam bka' bzhi la 'chad nyan yang dag mdzad pa gzigs pas/ ngas kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs 'di tsam yong pa gcig byung na dgongs pa byung ba la/ dus phyis bstan pa dang sems can la khong pas nga dngos su phan che ba gcig byung 'dug gsungs/ khri rgyal bsod nams lde pas/ 'phags pa thogs med sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen por 'dug pa la/ rje btsun byams pas dbu ma mi ston pa ci lags zhus pas/ 'o na a ma tshos bu tsha la dang por sgrub gong rdzis nas mi ster ba bar zla kha gter ba ci yin gsungs/ lan zhu ba'i spob pa dang bral lo/ /yang longs sprul sangs rgyas min zer ba mang po gda' lags pa/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/

ding sang gi mkhas pa 'di tsho la nges pa tsam mi 'dug ngas dus 'khor rgyud 'grel la 'gal 'du yod byas pa la/ chos spong gi las yin zer 'dug longs sprul sangs rgyas min zer mkhan byung rung / de 'dra'i lugs kyang yod zer nas ci ru yang mi sgom par 'dug ste/ longs sprul sangs rgyas min na/ mdo rgyud thams cad bka' min par 'gyur ba la sogs pa nyes pa shin tu che gsungs/ gnas brtan dngos grub na re/ 'u ba'i bla ma 'di'i kun spyod bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dug blun po gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas drag tsam/ phar tshad shes pa gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas drag tsam/ bka' bzhi mkhyen pa gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas drag tsam/ mkhan chen gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas ches mngon par mtho bar mdzad kyin 'dug nga ni lhag par de rang la mos pa gcig byung zer/ bka' bcu pa yon tan na re/ ngas bla ma 'di bas dkon mchog la dad gus che ba ma mthong gi grong jo bo la 'jal du byon res kyis jo bo'i phyag la 'jus nas/ spyan ras gzigs mgon khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /zhes sogs kyi sh+lau ka 'don kyin spyan chab phrol phrol yong gin 'dug zer/ de e bden nam snyam nas dus phyis ched du gnyer nas bdag gis kyang bltas pas/ bden par gda'o/ /gsang bu ba'i slob dpon rgyal dbang na re/ ngas bla ma su bya ba'i rtsar bsdad de/ sdug bsngal rang 'gag pa 'gro ba red mda' ba min pa ma mthong zer/ 'jam dbyangs pa na re/ 'ga' zhig da lta bod na slob dpon pas mkhas pa med zer na'ang / nga'i lugs kyi rgya gar shar nub rgya nag bal po rnams na bstan pa rnal ma med par 'dug pas da lta 'dzam bu gling na slob dpon mkhas pa bas mkhas pa med par go gsungs/ drung nas khri bskor gzhan du gshegs tsa na/ zhal du mi 'don yang thugs khral cher mdzad/ byang du phebs zer ba gsan ma khad shin tu gtam snyan rten gsum byin brlabs can re yod na'ang yod zer ba la/

de 'dra dang mnyam po min/ gzhung lugs pa chen po phyag phebs pa tsam gyis phyogs bkra shis pa yin zer nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad do/ /mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs pa na re/ nga'i bla ma'i yon tan chung shos gzhan gyis mi do/ bla ma ri phug tu bzhugs kyang / gos dar gyi na za 'phang med la bsgom/ gzhan sde bdag tu bsgom pa rnams kyang / nang du hrul chas gyon shing / phyir 'gro dus bzo par 'dug ste gsung shin tu mod/ smu rdzing na bzhugs dus bka' bcu pa don seng gis 'jal du phyin pas chos zhus/ grol ba dang 'gro ba'i grabs byas pas/ khyed de ring 'gro na rta zur gyi zam pa thon tsam der rgyugs gsungs/ bdag cag de phyogs la mi 'gro lags zhus pas/ a ha nga ni bul rong na yod pa'i bsam pa gcig byung 'dug gsungs/ bdag gis drung du phyin nas/ bka' bcu pa la de ltar gsungs lags sam zhus pas/ de byung / nga la bul rong gi lung pa ya gi pha yul gyi snang ba cig 'char gyin 'dug ste bag chag brtas pa yin gsungs/ ri khrod dga' mo ya gi rnyed pa 'phags chen chos bzang dpal gyi bka' drin yin gsungs/ 'phags chen chos bzang dpal la 'jal du byon dus khyed bstan pa rin po che'i bdag po yin pas/ de ltar thugs khur bzhes shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di khyed kyi phyag na yod do/ /bstan pa rin po che 'di la khyed shes so/ /zhes gsung nas/ phyag nas bzung zhing zhal lta mang po gnang ba'i mthar/ khyed kyis bstan pa rin po che la sngar phyag bzhes mdzad pa'i brtsom pa mdzad pa rnams kyi dkar chag kyang 'dir 'khod gsungs nas/ gong du bstan pa'i gsung sgros rnams dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa yar bcad lo 'di la 'di mdzad kyi dkar chag kyang mdzad do/ /drung nas grod chung du bzhugs dus/ kyi rong jo bo la phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu rnams tshod kyis brdung nas 'bul du btang pas/ krig ran par byung /

drung nas phyag tshad mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ ma byas che chung mtshams pa jo bo rang gi thugs rje yin gsungs/ bdag gis mkhan chen g.yag pa la 'jal du phyin dus khong pa la chos rje lo tsā ba/ rje btsun pa blo bzang grags pa gsum gang lhag zhus/ slob dpon gzhon blo ba lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ding sang dka' mor gtad yong gsung zhing / khong pas phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka de la bltas pas nang 'gal 'ga' yar 'dug khong byams chos sems tsam yin gsung na'ang / nga bka' ru de 'dod de/ byams pa sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ khong gsang 'dus pa chen po yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor mdzad kyin yod kyang / 'jam dbyangs dang byams pa gnyis sangs rgyas yin na yin snyam/ min na min snyam yin nga zer kyin 'dug slob dpon la zhus shig gsungs nas zhus pas/ nang 'gal than thun yod srid/ 'khrul med smra ba'i 'phags par ngas khas blang pa med/ khong gis nang 'gal du bzung ba rnams nang 'gal e yin mi shes/ bstan pa 'di gzhir bzhag la byams pa byang sems dang / byams chos lnga bstan bcos su bshad 'dug khong rang sangs rgyas pas lhag gsungs na'ang dbang che/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgya phar phyin theg pa la bkab rung zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa bya ba mkhas pa'i lugs ma yin gsungs/ mkhan chen chos dpal ba'i gsung nas 'u rang mthong lam thob thob lta ba'i lab ma zer/ de nas shes yong gsung zer pa drung du bskyar pas/ mthong lam lta ba'i rigs rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin pa la lta ba ma shes par mthong lam gcig thob ngos shes/ kha phye na zong zad pa'i lab yin gsung / chos rje lo tsā ba dang bla ma dbang pas gdan 'dren btang pas/ khams bzang zhing rten 'brel 'grig yong par zhu zhus pas/ lo tsā bas dgon pa brtsigs nas khal nyis stong tsam bsags/ de'i rgyab cha sha mar gos stan me shing sogs bsgrubs nas da nam phebs pa gcig yong na zhes yid smon du mdzad cing gdan 'dren pa btang pas/

nged na so rgas/ sha lus lcis pas/ 'grul mi pher ba 'dug gsungs nas/ thugs dam gyi gtso bor 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku mtshar mo gcig zhu rten la phul nas ma byon/ drung nas thugs shes kyis mkhyen nas stag tshang du dus gzing chen po yong pa dang / yon mchod gnyis ka'i sku tshe thung ngu las mi yong ba mkhyen nas ma byon par grags/ bul rong du snga rting la lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa la/ lo lnga drung pa rang gis thugs dam rtse gcig tu/ lo bdun la chos 'khor ci rigs su bskor cing bul rong shod du bzhugs dus mkhan chen dpal 'byor ba chos rje mchog bzang pas gtso mdzad chos kho na don du gnyer ba'i dge 'dun sha stag brgya bcu tsam la gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum lta khrid sogs zhib rgyas su gnang / gsan mkhan rnams la yang bya rgyu chos las med pas/ nyin mtshan chos kho nas 'da' ba byung / sa cha bgrod dka' mo der yang / sa skya tshun thams cad snyags nas/ bsnyen bkur bzang la mang ba byung / bul rong du bstan pa rnyed dang bkur stir bcas pa de bas lhag pa dus gsum du khyab zer ro/ /de'i phyi lo smu rdzing du slob dpon chen po nam mkha' dpa' bas gtso mdzad/ brag ram mkhan chen/ slob dpon las ston/ 'dar pa mgon seng / sgrub chen ma dpal mo yon bdag dpon po rtog ldan sogs brgya brgyad bcu tsam la gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ rtsa 'jug gnyis/ lta khrid dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /chos sum gnyis tsam song pa dang / sgrub chen ma dpal mo la/ nam smad mi ma yin chen po gcig dngos su yong nas khyod nam langs pa dang / bla ma'i drung du rgyugs la phyag gsum phul/ drung nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la yun ring du bzhugs su gsol zhes lan gsum gsol/ bar chad chen po byung dogs 'dug go zer ba de thos pas sgrub chen ma de langs te thugs ma bde ba byung / nam langs pa dang / drung du zhu ba gal can gcig yod pas/

cis kyang yong pa zhu zhus pas shogs gsungs nas/ gong du zer ba bzhin phyag phul gsol ba btab nas 'di bdag la gyis zer mkhan gcig byung pa ma gtogs bdag gis rdzun nam zog yin na drung gi bka' srung rnams kyis chad pa chod byas pas/ mna' skyel gyin khyed la rdzun yin zer ba'i gal med 'chi/ nged sa skyar 'chad nyan byed dus/ lo grangs 'di tsam na 'chi zer ba'i sgra chen po 'byung ba yin te/ de dus brtags pas/ re gcig pa la 'chi ba 'dug snyam pa byung / da lo mi 'chi yang sang phod skyas chen yin pas snyam gyin 'dug gsung / drung pa la skeg chen pas bsu skeg skyon che ba gcig gda' lags/ de dus kyi lo de gang yin brtsi bar zhu dang zhus pas/ rtsis pas sgrub chen ma dang gcig par byung / de nas chos grol ba dang / bul rong du byon pas sku mtshams dam po gcig mdzad par zhu/ bdag gis kyang gdan bzhugs gcig la 'ongs zhus nas rjes su gdan bzhugs zab po gcig phul bas lo 'ga' yar sku khams bzang po yong pa'i ltas byung gsungs/ de'i phyi lo mnga' ris phyogs sa cha bzang zhing / mi blo las su rung ba 'dug pas/ 'gro gsungs nas/ 'jam dbyangs pas rgya mkhar par brdas pas ma non/ chen po dpal ldan pas cung thugs brdas nas/ zhu ba phul yang ma gsan par mnga' ris su byon/ yar re res ne ring pa'i dbon po gnyis la dge tshul gyi bslab bya rnams gnang / dpon po rtog ldan pa la dge slong gi sdom pa rnams gnang / khong rnam pas kyang / 'bul 'degs phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas/ stag rtse bas grags na phar bskyal/ de nas mnga' ris pas bsu ste/ rdzong khar du phyag phebs/ gung thang khab pas shang len phun sum tshogs mdzad do/ /de nas mang yul du byon te/ rang byon 'phags pa'i drung du phyag dang mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ thang sher pa dpon po la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang nas/ me tog mdang can gyi nags khrod du sgrub pa la byon no/

/de dus gzhi bdag btsan rje zer ba/ chos la dkar ba gcig yod pa yong nas/ nga la chang gcig 'dren gyin 'dug chang mi 'thung pa la snyam pas mar khur song nas dum pa gcig 'thung nas bzhag 'bul ba zang zing mang po byed kyin 'dug de nas zhag bzhi lnga nas/ rgya'i 'bul ba de slebs byung / de gzhi bdag gis tshor ba 'dra snyam pa gcig byung gsungs/ de nas sku mtshams grol ba dang / bdag chen mas bod du spyan drangs/ dpon slob rnams ra 'dabs su dbyar rgyags bteg 'bul ba yang phun sum tshogs par phul/ de dus drung slob dpon mas gtso mdzad/ chen po chos dpal ba/ slob dpon yi dam dpal/ bka' bcu ba don yod seng ge ba la sogs brgya brgyad bcu tsam la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga/ lta khrid blo sbyong / rtsa 'jug gnyis/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa la sogs zab rgyas su gnang zhing / mnga' bdag sku mched/ bdag mo mched/ zhang blon 'ga' yar la yang gsang 'dus kyi dbang gnang / dpon zhang nam mkha' stobs rgyal ba khu dbon la bsnyen rdzogs dang rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / de dus mnga' bdag yum sras rnams la bstan 'gyur bzhongs gsungs zhal lta gnang pas/ bdag chen ma'i gsung nas/ drung nas thugs rjes bzung ba'i zhal lta yin/ bdag cag dang ci 'byor byed par zhu zhus pas/ de shin tu legs gsungs nas mnyes tshor cher mdzad do/ /khong tshos blos ma blangs na/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs kyang bod yul gyi 'bul snod thams cad khro phu'i byams pa bzhengs pa la btang gsungs/ ngas kyang spu rangs man chad 'di 'grims nas bstan 'gyur grub tsam gyi dngos cha 'grub bsams pa gcig byung na'ang / sde pas bzhengs pa shin tu legs gsungs nas/ bdag chen ma la/ bka' ru ma dngul bre chen gcig gos phyi nang bzang po lnga/ ber thul thong ris re re/ rgya'i rdor dril gcig gdan dkar rnams gnang nas/ bdag chen mas kyang / thugs khur cher bzhes 'bad rtsol bton pas/

lo gcig gi khongs su bar chad med par grub pas bla ma byin rlabs che zhing / yon bdag mo sku bsod dang blo stobs che ba'i grags pa byung ngo / /de nas rab gnas la rdzong khar spyan drangs te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad pas/ gsung rab zhal dro zhing byin brlabs che ba/ mchod gnas ngo dro yon bdag bkra shis pa phyogs byin chags pa'i rab gnas mdzad do/ /drung du gser ngon po srang bdun/ gos ta hun gyi snam bem gcig gis mgo byas 'bul snod rgya chen po mdzad dus/ drung gi zhal ltas bdag mo/ mi lus thob pa don yod pa bya ba de lta bu la zer ba yin/ chos la bya ba byas pa rang sangs rgyas su skye bar mdo sde du ma nas gsungs/ ding sang yang dbus gtsang gi sde pa su stobs che yang / snag shog glegs shing / blo bu dgos na 'byor pa shin tu dka'/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge rtsa bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba yang rgya chen po mdzad do/ /bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i mgo tshugs pa tsam la/ drung nas bla ma sgrub pa dpal la bstan 'gyur 'di bar chad med par 'grub par 'dug nga'i rmi lam du dbus gtsang thams cad du thos pa'i dung theng bdun 'bus pa rmis gsungs/ rwa sgreng du bzhugs dus mtshan lam du/ chos rje blo bzang pa dang gnyis gzhung lam chen po gcig la sangs rgya ru 'gro ba zer 'gro yin 'dug pas/ blo bzang pa 'gyog tsam 'gro yi 'dug khong lam na mchod rten gcig 'dug pa la bskor ba byed cing 'dug ngas ma byas par phyin pas/ sangs rgyas pa yin zer ba'i khri chen po gcig 'dug pa der ngas sngon la 'dzegs/ khong gis kyang de ma khad phebs byon/ khong las khyed sangs rgya bar zhu byas pas/ khong na re/ bla ma byang chub sngon la mdzad par zhu zer nas ngas sngon la sangs rgyas pa rmis/ khong bar skabs su bskor ba byed pa de/ rang don yid byed gcig byung ba yin nam snyam pa byung gsungs/

de la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yon tan mtha' yas so/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi che btsun 'byor ldan gyis/ /gus pas spyan dang rnyed dang bkur stis mchod/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed gdams pa mang du zhus/ /kun gyi mchod 'os khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i rigs dang gtong pa la sogs pa mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun gyi mngon par mtho ba 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen pas/ bdag nyid chen po mkhas pa'i grags pa thob nas su 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su dpon slob rnams yang yang btegs/ gsung sgros mang po bzhengs nas/ blo gsal rnams la gnang / bzhengs mkhan rnams la yang snag shog sogs chas kha mang po gnang / gsung sgros la 'chad nyan mdzad pa rnams kyi bdag rkyen yang dag pa mdzad/ bul rong du phyag phebs mar bcad kyang / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bya bral ba gang byung rnams btegs/ bkren pa rnams la ci 'dod kyi gsung sgros rnams bris nas gnang ba sogs bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i zhabs tog yang dag pa mdzad pas na/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi gtso bo yin no/ /rigs dang rus dang / cho 'phrang gis mngon par mtho ba khri rgyal bsod nams lde pa yab yum gyis dpon slob gang yod lo gnyis kyi bar du btegs/ mnga' ris su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bdag rkyen yang mdzad cing / dpon slob rnams la 'bul snod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pas sbyin bdag gi mchog yin no/ /snel pas/ dpon slob 'khor bcas dga' ba gdong dang / rwa sgreng du nam bzhugs bar bteg cing / 'bul snod rgya chen po yang mdzad/ dpon yon tan rgya mtshos gnam rtse ldeng du bzhugs dus/ rgyag 'khor mar bteg cing / 'bul snod phun sum tshogs pa yang mdzad/ gling dkar bas yar mar gyi zhabs tog 'bul snod bcas pa yang bsgrubs/ gnas snying stong dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos 'chad nyan mdzad dus/ dpon slob rnams kyi bshad nyan gyi bdag rkyen yang dag pa mdzad/

'bri khung chen po shes rab dpal bas/ na bza' ja dkar sig chen la sogs 'bul snod rgya chen po bsgrubs/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos nas khal brgya phul nas/ slob dpon rnams bteg chu 'dus pas spyan drangs nas/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen 'bul snod yang dag pa mdzad/ shri ri 'dzam bu gling du bsod nams 'od zer bas/ dpon slob rnams kyi dbyar rgyags bteg nas chos 'khor bskor/ mang yul seng ge mkhar du dbon po bsod nams grub kyis dpon slob 'khor bcas zla gcig bteg nas chos 'khor bskor/ lan 'de gung stings su bla ma 'jam dpal gling pa lcam sring gis dpon slob sum brgya tsam zla ba gsum gyi bar du btegs/ drung du yang na bza' la sogs 'bul snod phun sum tshogs pa dang / bya bral ba rnams la'ang na bza' re phul/ stag rtse bas smu rdzing du chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen dang yar mar gyi dpon slob rnams kyi zhabs tog 'bul snod dang bcas pa mdzad/ khyad par khong rang grongs dus/ thugs dam 'dog thig po zho drug bcu rtsa drug 'gor ba gcig phul/ bya bral ba rnams la'ang 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ drung a phyi ba dang / dpon zhang kun spangs pas 'bul 'degs bzang po mdzad/ khyad par drung slob dpon mas zhabs tog gi 'thil du zhugs nas yang dag pa mdzad/ shes rab pa sku mched pas kyang zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang mnga' ris kyi dpon rig 'byor ldan dad pa can rnams kyis zhabs tog yang dag pa bsgrubs/ drung nas kyang dbus gtsang gi sbyin bdag de rnams thams cad la dbang bskur/ sems bskyed lung khrid la sogs gang la gang 'os kyi chos kyi 'brel pa gnang nas/ dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan pa mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas dngos lta bur mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas gangs can gyi skye bo phal mo che'i 'dren pa dam par gyur to/ /kun mkhyen shes 'od la sogs pa mdo khams kyi bu slob rnams dang /

bka' bcu pa kun dga' dpal la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi bu slob rnams kyis kyang 'byor pa dang btun nas gus pas mchod do/ /gzhan yang gnam gyi mtha' ma rgya nag po'i yul nas/ ta ming rgyal pos rgyan gos bzang po phyi nang lnga/ snam sbyar bzang po/ sku 'gag ber thul/ thong rings/ dbu theb/ lham/ sku skyeg phyag phreng / rdor dril cha gnyis/ ting shag cha gnyis/ rten khebs gnyis/ gdan dkar gnyis/ gsol khebs gcig maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyan gsum/ tsan+dan dkar po gdum gcig ja dkar rgya ma lnga bcu rnams phul/ gu ge rgyal pos/ kha che gur gum zho lnga bcu'i mgo byas 'bul snod mang du byung ngo / /'brug gi lo la mya ngan 'da' dgongs nas/ /go rtog nyams su myong ba'i zab don rnams/ /ston pas bstan pa gtod pa ji bzhin du/ /chos 'khor nan 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni mang gung gi mtshams gling rtse dpal gyi dben gnas su/ 'brug gi lo la dge 'dun brgya phrag gcig la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su/ de'i lo mya ngan las 'da' ba mkhyen nas/ gung lo drug cu rtsa lnga'i bar du thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa zab mo phyin ci ma log pa rtogs shing / thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i don rnams ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od srungs chen po dang / kun dga' bo la sogs la nga'i mdo sde rin po che 'di khyed la gtad do/ /khyed rnams kyis zungs shig chongs shig lhogs shig kun chub par gyis shig gzhan la yang rgya cher ston cig ces yang dang yang du gsungs pa bzhin du/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang / gdul bya'i tha ma rnams la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ lta khrid tshar gnyis/ 'jug pa tshar gsum btud nas gsungs/ rtsa ba tshar gcig rgyas par gsungs/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed lan gnyis nyin gcig la gsungs/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang thengs gnyis gnang / lce bsgom rdzong pa'i man ngag rin spungs kyi lung gnang /

bya bral ba rnams kyis lo mang po'i bar du gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa bka' 'bum thor bu ba'i lung rnams gnang / sngar nas gsungs pa dang mi 'dra bar dka' ba'i gnas rnams lan gsum gsum bskyar nas gsungs/ de ltar nges par gyis shig ces yang yang gsungs zhing / khyad par du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs kha na ma tho ba med pa 'di la ma brten par sangs rgya mi nus par khas len e nus/ zhes chos mgo gzhug la lan gnyis gsum gsungs kyang / lan zhu mkhan ma byung 'dug bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed pas sangs rgya ba'i thabs rdo rje theg pa dang / phar phyin theg pa gnyis las ma gsungs shing / de gnyis kyi lam gyi gtso bo yang rdzogs rim dang lta ba rnam gnyis yin la/ de gnyis ming tha dad kyis bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo bdag med pa'i shes rab kho na yin/ des ston pa'i gnas kyi don de las gnas lugs kyi don gzhan dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs shing / de phyin ci ma log par 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bstan pa 'di kho na yin snyam du dgongs pa yin/ 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi lugs las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /zhes pas gzhung 'jug par mdzad pa yin no/ /dbang gnang dus dang / dbu ma'i skabs 'ga' yar du spyan chab yang yang gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni chos dang chos smra ba'i gang zag la dad cing gus pa skyes pa'i/ ngas klu sgrub kyi lta ba bzang po 'di bstan kyang / dad pa tsam ma gtogs phyin ci log par go ba ma byung par/ gdul bya thugs chad nas zer lo gyis dang / go ba mi go gsung pa dang / ye gsang chen mor 'dug gi gsung zhing / zab mo lta ba'i bstan pa nub 'gro bar gzigs te/ thugs mug nas bshums par go'o/ /'khor 'das chos kun skye ba med dran nas/ /de nyid ngang la mya ngan 'da' bzhed na'ang / /gus pas gsol btab ngo ru zhag bdun bar/

/sku tshe byin brlabs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / gang tshe de nyid skye med yin zhing blo dang skye ba dang bral ba/ /zhes pa'i skabs su yul can gyis bsdus pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad skye ba med par bstan to/ /rang nyid kyang chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed nas bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan na yang / gdul bya rnams kyi mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa'i ngor zhag bdun gyi bar/ sku tshe byin gyis brlabs nas sku khams dngas te/ da lo'i chos 'di bar chad kyang mang pa gcig byung bas/ grol ba'i rigs mi 'dug gsungs nas/ dmigs pa spungs nas gnang / 'jug pa'i bshad pa yang grol bar mdzad do/ /'chi ba 'od gsal lus la brten mi srid/ /lus sems bral nas rnams shes stong par zhugs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal yin no zhes/ /yang yang gsung pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di ding sang gi man ngag pa phal cher nyer thob mun chen gyi gnas skabs su zhi gnas kyi mthus sems lus la yun ring du gnas pa la/ 'chi ba 'od gsal du 'dod na'ang de 'dra mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin/ lus sems bral nas stong chen chos kyi dbyings su zhugs nas/ dbyings rig dbyer med du gyur pa la 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes zer ba yin/ 'di ltar bshad na mang po gcig dgra ru 'gro ste/ 'di mi zer kha med yin pas/ thams cad kyi yid la zungs shig ces mang du gsungs so/ /sngar bsgoms 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal btab nas/ /rtags rnams ma brjed dga' spros 'od gsal 'jug /'gog la ldang zhing sngon gyis 'phen pas 'pho/ /gsung zhing mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di deng sang gi 'chi tsa na 'pho ba 'debs zer ba'i lag len gcig dar 'dug na'ang / phyi dbug ma chad pa la 'debs pa yin/ phyi dbugs chad nas btab kyang thos pa'i go skabs med/ de'ang / sngar 'pho ba'i gnad man ngag sgom myong na/

mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa la gzhan gyis 'pho ba 'debs pa yin/ man ngag ma thob pa'i skye bo tha mal pa la 'pho ba'i man ngag bstan kyang kho la ci yang mi phan/ de bas mtshan dang / gzungs byin rlabs can brjod pa don che/ man ngag dang ldan pa 'chi ba'i tshe/ sngar rang gis bsgoms pa'i 'pho ba'i man ngag rnams legs par gsal btab nas/ nga 'di 'dra gcig tu skyes na snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag tu sngon du btang nas/ 'byung ba bzhi thim pa'i rtags dang / snang ba gsum shar ba'i rtags rnams ma brjed par byas nas/ rtags rnams rdzogs pa dang / da nga 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon sum du byed pa 'dug snyam pa'i dga' spro cher skye zhing / pha khyim du bu 'gro ba ltar brod pa dang bcas nas chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pa la 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa zer ba yin/ de'i ngang la 'pho ba'i rnam rtog med kyang / mngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis gang 'dod pa'i skyes gnas su 'phen nus pa la 'pho ba thebs pa zer ba yin/ nyan thos rnams 'gogs pa la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ zhag dang zla ba dang lo 'di tsam gyi bar du snyoms par 'jug cing / snyoms 'jug gi ngang las ldang ba'i 'du shes med kyang sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis dus las mi 'da' bar ldang ba yin/ dper na gnyid log pa'i sngon la nang par snga mor ldang mnyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas nyal bas/ gnyid kyi ngang la ldang ba'i blo med kyang / 'phen pas snga mor gnyid sad pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsung zhing / ji ltar gsung ba bzhin du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus su yang mngon du mdzad do/ /sku tshe 'di yi dngos kyi gdul bya la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zin nas/ /'chi ba 'od gsal skabs su gzhan don gshegs/ /skye 'chi dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar gyi gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par zab pa don dam bden pa dang /

rgya che ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor zin nas/ rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' ba la 'jigs pa dang / ya nga ba dang / bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal gyi sgrub chen ma na re/ tshe sgrub ma mdzad na sku tshe thung zer gda' lags/ tshe sgrub mdzad na zhus pas/ drug cu kha ral gyis dus su/ drug cu rtsa lnga song 'dug da tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel mi sgrigs gsung ba dang / snyung pa ldog pa'i snga dro bla ma rgyal bzang gis phyag phul nas/ drung nas bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don la zhabs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ da na ba yun thung ba dang / 'chi ba zug chung ba byung na bsam pa ma gtogs bya ba 'di rang ma 'grub snyam pa'i blo'i lhag ma lus pa med gsungs nas/ gang la skyabs na bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa/ /sems snong med kyi glu skad 'di bzhin len/ /shul na 'phreng ba'i zas nor lus pa med/ /gdong na 'tsher ba'i las ngan bsags pa med/ /theg chen bslab pa'i bsam sbyor nyams pa med/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /ci snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i shes rab yod/ /'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i lhag bsam yod/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len yod/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /thog mar gsung rab dgongs don tshul bzhin btsal/ /bar du blo gsal gdul bya'i tshogs la bshad/ /tha mar 'dris pa'i don la rtse gcig bsgoms/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog las gces par bzung / /rigs dang mi rigs tshul bzhin rnam par phye/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas dal 'byor don yod byas/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/

/'gyod med bde drod kyi mgur ma 'di/ /gangs bu le'i 'gul du blangs pa yin/ /mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug bskal ldan rnams/ /mi nga bzhin byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /gsung ba bzhin gong du bstan pa de ltar 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa rgyas par gsungs nas/ chos nang par gyi grol bar gda'o/ /zhes gsungs zhing / nang par chos gsung ba'i dus mar bcad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ gsung mi gnang zhing / gsol mi dgongs tsam ma gtogs snyung zug med pas/ thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams ma chag cing / ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin 'pho ba mdzad nas/ 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu'i nyi shar la/ sku lus gzugs kyi sku 'od gsal chos kyi skur mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /skye 'chi la dbang thob pa yin te/ bsam bzhin du srid pa bzhes zhing bzhed pa shin tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag /'od gsal don dam bden pa mngon du gyur/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes/ /phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis 'chi ba 'od gsal las bar du sgyu lus su bzhengs nas/ kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag pa mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa longs sku mnyes te/ rten de nyid la 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku mngon sum du mngon du mdzad pa ni/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyed par 'gyur te/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'bad med lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du gzhan don mdzad pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho skems par mdzad do/ /zhing gzhan gshegs tshe sa chen rab tu g.yos/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha rnams 'dus gyur te/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho nas/ /mchod nas spyan drangs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa rnams bltams pa dang /

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i sa g.yo bar/ mdo las gsungs pa ltar byung ba kun la gsal lo/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu sogs nam mkha' la 'dus par gyur te/ phyi'i mchod pa 'dod yon lnga/ nang mchod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba'i mchod pa dga' bzhi'i bde ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta bas rang rang gis ji ltar nus pa ltar mchod nas/ bdag nyid chen po gar gshegs pa'i gnas su spyan drangs pa yin no/ /kun gyis thos pa'i dung dang rnga bo che'i sgra skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / sngar snam ma myong ba'i dri bzang po kun gyis tshor ba yang yang byung / bla ma bsod nams grags pa sogs 'ga' yar gyi mtshan mo bla brang kun 'od kyis khengs pa gzigs/ de la sogs pa dge ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /ye shes me yis khyod sku bzhu ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la sprin med bar snang rlung yang zhi/ /sa la drod rgyas dbyar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /rten 'brel dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phye nas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyas par phul te/ ye shes lnga'i mes rnam par smin pa'i sku sbyang ba'i tshe/ skad cig de nyid la rgyan nam mkha' sprin sogs sgrib g.yogs kun dang bral zhing bai ḍūr+ya'i rang mdog yongs su rdzogs par bstan/ bar snang la rlung dang tshub ma sogs kyi rdul dang bral bar gyur/ sa gzhi la glo bur drod cher rgyas te/ grang pas nyen dang bral ba/ dbyar bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la dbang thob/ lta ba rnam par dag pa'i mthu yin par kun gyis go'o/ /ston pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad bgos pa bzhin/ /khyod gdung dad ldan lha mi grangs med kyis/ /phyogs bcur spyan drangs mchod pa'i rten du gyur/

/sku gdung rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ sngon gyi gyad kyis yul shing sa la zung gi drung du/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus du/ sku gdung ring bsrel rnams lha dang klu dang mi rnams kyi cha brgyad du bgos pa bzhin du/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gdung byin brlabs kyi snying po can rnams kyi skal ba/ lha klu sogs mi ma yin gyis kyang spyan drangs par grags te/ gdung khang zhal phye dus phyag zhabs kyi rkang 'ga' yar ma tshang par mthun snang du grub bo/ /lhag ma rnams nang rten phyi rten sku 'dra'i nang du gzhug rgyu dang / bu slob kyi mchog chos rje blo bzang grags pas gtso mdzad rab tu byung ba'i gdul bya rnams dang / sbyin bdag gi mchog tu gyur pa khri bsod nams rgyal mtshan lde pa sku mched kyis thog drangs khyim pa'i gdul bya rnams la bkye nas lha klu'i gnas dang / bod gangs can gyi khrod thams cad du mchod pa'i rten du gyur to/ /mthong thos dran reg gtam du brjod rnams kyi/ /'di phyi bar do'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dpal ldan red mda' ba/ /'dren mchog dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma de'i sku mthong ba'am/ gsung thos pa'i yon tan dran pa'am/ phrin las kyis reg pa'am/ mtshan brjod pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi tshe 'di'i sku drin mgon/ phyi ma'i skyabs/ bar do'i dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa gnas skabs dang / mthar thug kun tu bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas 'dren mchog dam pa de la bdag sogs gdul bya thams cad sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /bstod do/ /rnam pa kun tu rjes su gzung du gsol/ kye ma kye hud bstan pa'i srog shing chag /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun phyogs bcur 'thor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud thar pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyel/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi thar lam stor lags so/

/kye ma kye hud legs bshad dga' ston nyams/ /blo gsal rnams kyi re thag bcad lags so/ /kye ma kye hud lta ba'i nyi ma nub/ /klu sgrub yab sras lugs bzang su yis skyong / /kye ma kye hud dam chos rgya mtsho skams/ /thogs med sku mched bshad srol su yis ston/ /kye ma kye hud lung rigs mche sder 'thor/ /phyogs glang chos grags rigs tshul su yis spel/ /kye ma kye hud tshul khrims bum pa zhig /yon shag rnam gnyis sdom rgyun su yis 'dzin/ /kye ma kye hud spangs rtogs go rim 'chol/ /'phags seng gnyis kyi legs bshad su yis bsgrog /kye ma kye hud nyams rtogs byin brlabs yal/ /te lo nā ro'i man ngag su la zhu/ /kye ma kye hud phan bde'i pad tshal zum/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa gcig car nub lags so/ /kye ma kye hud nyam thag yi re mug /khyod sku mig gis mthong ba'i skal bas dben/ /khyod gsung rna bas thos pa'i bsod nams med/ /khyed thugs gang na bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlobs/ /rjes su mchod pa phul ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma bsod nams grags pas gtso mdzad/ bu slob brgya phrag gcig lhag tsam gyis zhag bco brgyad kyi bar du phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di dag gis zhal phye nas gus pas gsol ba btab pa ni/ bla ma bsod nams grags pa dang / chen po chos dpal ba gnyis kyis gtso mdzad kyis/ kyai rdo rje slob dpon yi dam dpal ba dang / bla ma yon tan rgyal bas gtso mdzad rnams kyis kun rig bla ma rgyal bzang pas gtso mdzad/ bya bral ba rnams kyis chos rje'i thugs dam gyi gtso bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon bka' bzhi pas gtso mdzad dge 'dun bying gis bde gshegs brgyad la mchod pa/ bdag gis bla ma mchod pa la sogs pa'i sgrub mchod phul te gsol ba btab/ de dus nang so rang gi phyag rdzas gang yod kyis ci ldang byas pa'i lhag ma/

khab nang sos zhag gsum/ bdag chen mas zhag gnyis/ drung dpon slob mas gtso mdzad rnams kyis zhag gsum btegs nas/ gdung gi drung nas gtso mdzad dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bskur 'bul 'degs phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do/ /nang rten rang byon 'phags pa'i sku tshad mnyam pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri rgyab dang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i zangs gser/ bzo gnas pa'i yon rgyags sogs kyi sbyin bdag gis thil/ drung bdag po pas mdzad cing / gzhan yang bdag chen mas gtso mdzad/ bu slob rnams kyis dad cing gus pas phul ba dang / nang so rang gi thig po sogs phyag rdzas kyi bzhugs gang yod btang nas/ mang yul 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol cing / sku 'dra'i sbyin bdag chen po chos dpal bas mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang de nyid na bzhugs pa'i spyan mngar bdag nyid chen po rang gis/ jo bo'i drung du phul ba'i skong bu la dngul dam gcig mnan nas/ skong rkyen bzang po brtsegs te phul ba'o/ /rten gnyer chen po dang / slob dpon yon rin pas mdzad/ thil bzhugs bla ma rgyal bzang pa dang / nye gnas mchog legs kyis mdzad do/ /dge legs yon tan chu gter chen po las/ /chu thig tsam zhig blangs la nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /zhabs 'bring gnyug ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar smad byung ba'i/ /bshes gnyen bsod nams grags sogs bkas bskul nas/ /grangs med gdul bya'i tha shal mnga' ris pa/ /mi phyed dad thob sangs rgyas rtse mos sbyar/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /bla ma mchog la gus pas phul ba yis/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs 'jug par shog /rnam thar zhib rgyas su brjod pa blo'i yul ma yin zhing / drung rang nas kyang ngas 'di ltar byas/ 'di bzhin byung sogs cher mi gsung pa dang /

rgyun du zhabs tog phul ba'i rgyus can la 'dris med pa'i stobs kyis/ go rim gong 'og nor ba sogs nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ 'dis phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa 'di dbang phyug mi la ras chen gyi sti gnas rkang tshugs phug gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// //dge legs su gyur cig rje btsun chen po red mda' ba'i gsung sgros mdor bsdus pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 58 sangs rgyas rtse mo/ red mda' ba chen po gzhon nu blo gros kyi rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 59
